name: Tip Tracker: Server Income
description:
Tip Tracker: Server Income is a tip tracker for servers and bartenders who want a clear record of each shift. Enter your tips, hours, base wage and tip-outs, then review the income you recorded and your effective hourly pay. The app interface is in English.

KEEP ONE RECORD FOR EACH SHIFT
Record cash tips and card tips separately so you can see how a shift's total was formed. Add the amount shared with coworkers as a tip-out, enter your working hours and include your base wage when it applies. These are your own entries: the app does not connect to a restaurant's point-of-sale system, employer payroll or bank account.

See the result for that shift without reconstructing it from a calendar note. The hourly figure uses the pay, tips, tip-outs and hours you entered. A missing or incorrect entry changes the result, so you can return to a record and correct the facts rather than treating the displayed amount as an employer-issued statement.

SEPARATE YOUR JOBS
Keep records for different jobs and look at the income attached to each one. This is useful when you work at more than one restaurant, split your week between serving and bartending, or want to distinguish shifts with different base wages. Your own job names keep those records recognizable. Check that the wage entered for a new shift matches the work you did.

REVIEW DAYS, WEEKS AND MONTHS
Use the calendar and shift history to find a particular day. Weekly and monthly totals bring recorded earnings together, while hourly summaries help account for different amounts of time worked. Day-of-week comparisons show patterns in your own past entries. They do not predict what another shift will pay or promise that choosing a particular day will increase your income.

HANDLE THE DETAILS THAT CHANGE A TOTAL
Cash, card tips and shared tips play different roles in the calculation. Recording each amount makes it easier to check why two shifts with similar sales produced different take-home totals. If you enter sales, you can also review the tip percentage calculated from those figures. Sales are optional context, not an automatic connection to a register.

For late service, the after-midnight day setting helps keep a shift associated with the working day you intend. Review that choice when your schedule crosses midnight so the calendar reflects how you organize your work. Hours and amounts remain manually entered; the app is not a time clock that verifies attendance.

TAKE YOUR RECORDS WITH YOU
Export a CSV when you want the recorded values and calculations in a spreadsheet. The CSV is an export for your own review; it is not a tax return, a payroll filing or a backup that the app can import. Check the dates and values you share before sending a file to someone else.

A separate JSON backup preserves supported app records and settings. Keep a copy in a location you control. Restoring a valid backup replaces the current local records, so check the file and keep a recent copy before restoring. Backup files are plain text and should be stored with care if they contain information you consider private.

YOUR OWN INCOME HISTORY
Core records are stored locally without creating an account. Exporting or sharing a file sends that chosen copy through the destination you select. Purchase processing and app updates are separate from the personal shift log; local record storage is not a promise that every service interaction stays on the device.

Use the app to organize recorded income and compare your own work history. Its figures depend on the details you supply and are not tax, legal or financial advice. Confirm wages, withholding, reporting duties and payroll differences with the relevant employer or qualified professional. A useful shift log gives you a clearer set of facts to review; it does not guarantee future earnings.

description:

name: Cocktail App: Home Bartender
description:
Home Bartender is a cocktail app built around one question: what can I make with the bottles I already own? Tick off the spirits, liqueurs, mixers and garnishes in your home bar, and the app shows every cocktail and mocktail you can pour right now, plus the ones that are just one bottle away.

Whether you are stocking a first home bar, planning drinks for friends, or just want mixology made easy, the app keeps it practical: real measures, clear steps and no guesswork.

MY BAR
• Pick from nearly 100 ingredients (vodka, gin, rum, whiskey, tequila, liqueurs, bitters, mixers and garnishes), sorted by category with search.
• Mark each bottle as full, low or empty, so your list keeps up as you pour and restock.
• Your next three bottles: a buying plan that shows what each purchase unlocks, and which bottles only one spec needs.
• Tick your glassware and tools. If something is missing, you get a workaround, never a dead end.

WHAT CAN I MAKE?
• "You can make now" lists every cocktail and mocktail your shelf covers today.
• "Missing just 1" shows what is one ingredient away and names that ingredient.
• Make it anyway: when you are short of something, a swap re-balances the measures around what is on your shelf.

COCKTAIL RECIPES AND MOCKTAILS
• More than 120 drink recipes: classic cocktails like the Margarita, Mojito, Negroni and Old Fashioned, plus alcohol-free mocktail recipes.
• Each one lists the glass, the method (shaken, stirred, built or blended), the measures and step-by-step instructions.
• Search, filter by base spirit or family, or switch on Mocktails Only.
• Measures in ml or oz.
• Like or dislike a spec and save favorites for next time.

LEARN MIXOLOGY
• Drink families: sours, highballs, spritzes, punches and more. Learn the master ratio behind each one and improvise like a mixologist.
• Technique tips: tap a highlighted word in the steps (muddle, dry-shake, double-strain) to see why it matters and the common mistake.
• A handy bartending reference for mixed drinks at home, whatever your level.

AI BARTENDER
• Describe what you feel like in plain words, for example "something sour and gin-based", and get matches from your real bar inventory.
• See what each suggestion uses from your shelf and what, if anything, is missing.
• Set a taste profile, a preferred base spirit and an alcohol-free mode so suggestions fit you.
• Needs an internet connection.

HOSTING AND PREP
• Host Mode: say how many guests are coming, including those not drinking alcohol, and get a three-drink cocktail menu your shelf can serve, with a shopping list and a prep order.
• Batch a recipe for a crowd with the dilution worked out (Pro).
• Prep Reminders: log fresh syrup or citrus juice and get a reminder before it turns.
• Pour Log: tap "I poured this" to keep an estimate of standard drinks for the week.

WHAT'S FREE
• My Bar, What Can I Make, swaps, the full recipe library, drink families, technique tips, favorites, Host Mode, Prep Reminders and Pour Log.
• 3 AI Bartender requests a month. When they run out, you can watch an ad for a bonus request (one per day).
• One saved party menu.
• The free version shows ads.

PRO
• Unlimited AI Bartender requests
• Batch any cocktail for a crowd
• Save every party menu you plan
• No ads

Pro is an optional auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly. The price is shown in the app before you buy. Cancel any time in Google Play: Payments & subscriptions.

YOUR DATA
Your bar list, favorites and taste settings are stored on your device, and the recipe library is built into the app. AI Bartender requests are sent to our server to generate suggestions.

DRINK RESPONSIBLY
Home Bartender is a recipe and mixology reference for adults of legal drinking age in their country. It does not sell or deliver alcohol. Every cocktail recipe carries a reminder to drink responsibly and never drink and drive.

name: Tip+: Restaurant Tip Manager
description:

Every restaurant splits tips differently. Some pool everything and divide by hours. Some tip out the bar 10%, the food runners 5%, and the busser a flat amount. Some pay servers on sales, not tips. Most tip calculators pick one of these and force you to live with it. Tip+ lets you set your own rules — and change them shift by shift when reality doesn't cooperate.

DOWN TO EARTH, NOT OVERBUILT

Tip+ is made for the person who closes the restaurant at midnight, not for an accounting department. No jargon. No forced workflows. No "enterprise" features you'll never touch. Open the app, enter what happened tonight, split the tips, go home.

CUSTOMIZE EVERYTHING

• Splits your way — by hours, by role weight, by fixed percentage, by flat amount, or any combination.
• Role weights — servers 1.0, bar 0.8, runners 0.5 — whatever your house rule is.
• Tip-outs — pull a percentage off the top for the kitchen, bar, or support before the pool is split.
• Overrides — bump someone up for a great night, adjust for a mid-shift role change, or exclude a no-show, all with a note attached.
• Templates — save the shift structures you run every week so setup takes seconds.

WHAT'S INSIDE

Dashboard — today's tips, active shifts, and recent settlements at a glance.

Staff & Groups — add employees, assign roles, and group them (servers, bar, kitchen, support). Bulk import from a spreadsheet if you're switching over.

Shifts — build shifts from templates or on the fly. Import daily sales sheets or tip totals so you're not retyping POS numbers.

Settlements — run a settlement for any shift. Tip+ shows the source tips, the formula, and the per-person breakdown. Nothing hidden.

Audit Logs — every edit, every settlement, every override is captured so nothing gets quietly changed after the fact.

Multi-location — run more than one restaurant from a single account and switch in one tap.

Languages — English and Simplified Chinese.

BUILT FOR THE MESSY REALITY

Split shifts, mid-shift role changes, a bartender who covered a section for an hour, a no-show, a comp that changes the tip pool — Tip+ handles the awkward stuff without breaking the audit trail. Because that's the actual job.

WHY TIP+

• Fair — every split is transparent and the math is visible.
• Fast — close a shift in minutes.
• Flexible — your rules, not ours.
• Trustworthy — full audit log so staff and owners both know the numbers weren't fudged.

PRIVACY

Your data stays yours. We don't sell employee or tip information.

Tip+: Restaurant Tip Manager is part of the Tip+ family, alongside Tip+: Hotel Tip Collection and the tipplus.org owner dashboard.

Stop fighting a rigid calculator. Download Tip+ and split tips the way your restaurant actually does it.

name: Tipd
description:
Tipd lets you collect cashless tips and donations with nothing more than a QR code or NFC tag. A guest scans, pays with Apple Pay, Google Pay or any major card, and the entire amount you were meant to receive arrives in your bank within two working days. There is no reader to charge, no monthly subscription and no money lost to hidden fees. The small processing cost is shown to the supporter as a separate line so what they intend to give is exactly what you get.

It works anywhere. Put the QR on a café table, a tour badge, a salon mirror, a brass-band programme or inside a delivery bag. Charities use Tipd to capture Gift Aid without plug-ins or spreadsheets. Restaurants and bars avoid payroll headaches because tips never touch the business bank account. Tour guides let the whole group tip at once and can share earnings automatically with a driver or crew. Independent creators and buskers finally have a reliable fallback when fans have no cash.

Payments run through Ryft, an FCA regulated provider. Every transaction is protected by PCI DSS and 3-D Secure. Your dashboard shows real-time totals, automatic splits for teams and a ready-to-export Gift Aid file. Payouts settle in GBP or EUR today and USD is on the way for 2025.

Getting started takes about two minutes. Create your Tipd link, print or share the QR and you are ready to accept cashless gratitude wherever you work or perform.

If you serve tables, guide tours, cut hair, deliver parcels, play music or raise funds for a cause, Tipd makes it easy to accept digital tips and donations while keeping every penny that was meant for you.

name: Tip+: Hotel Tip Collection
description:
Tip+ Hotel Tip Collection is the tipping companion for hotel housekeeping and service staff. Scan a room's QR code, claim the tip a guest left for you, and see your earnings in real time.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Your hotel places a small QR code in every room.
2. Guests scan the code with their phone camera and leave a tip through a secure payment page — no cash, no envelopes.
3. When you finish cleaning or servicing the room, open Tip+ and scan the same QR code. The tip is instantly credited to you.

If two of you worked the room together, split it evenly in one tap.

FEATURES

• Scan-to-claim — Instantly claim the tip in the room you just serviced.
• Solo or split — Claim on your own, or split by parts with coworkers who helped.
• Report duplicates — If someone else already claimed a room, flag it in one tap.
• My tips — Every room you cleaned today, with a running total.
• Statements — Review past pay periods based on your hotel's settlement cycle (weekly, semi-monthly, or monthly), plus your current unsettled balance.
• Secure sign-in — Access with the email and password your hotel provisions for you.

TRANSPARENT AND FAIR

Every dollar of tip goes to the staff who earned it. Guests pay all processing fees on top of the tip, so the amount you see in the app is the amount you actually take home. All claims are time-stamped and visible to your hotel manager, so there's no confusion about who claimed which room.

GETTING STARTED

You'll need an account from your hotel employer. Ask your manager or owner to add you — they'll send a link to set your password. Once you're signed in, you'll see the rooms assigned to you and can start scanning.

Are you a hotel owner or manager? Visit https://tipplus.org to set up your property, invite staff, and print room QR codes.

PRIVACY AND PAYMENTS

• Your account is tied to your hotel and never sees data from other properties.
• We never sell or share your personal data.
• All payments are processed by Stripe, a global industry-standard payment provider.

SUPPORT

For help, contact your hotel manager or reach out through https://tipplus.org.

name: Geo Tracker - GPS tracker
description:
If you are looking for an excellent GPS tracker, that can work with Open Street Maps or Google, love outdoor activities, or travel - this is the app for you!


Record GPS tracks of your trips, analyze statistics, and share them with your friends!


Geo Tracker can help:
• Making the way back in an unfamiliar area without getting lost;
• Sharing your route with friends;
• Using someone else's route from GPX, KML or KMZ file;
• Marking important or interesting points on your way;
• Locating a point on the map, if you know its coordinates;
• Showing off colorful screenshots of your accomplishments on social networks.


You can view the tracks and the surrounding area in the application using a scheme from OSM or Google, as well as satellite images from Google or Mapbox - this way you will always have the most detailed map of the area anywhere worldwide. The map areas you view are saved to your phone and remain available offline for a while (this works best for OSM maps and Mapbox's satellite images). To record and calculate track statistics only a GPS signal is needed - the Internet is only required to download map images.


While driving, you can turn on the navigation mode, in which the map automatically rotates in the direction of travel, which greatly simplifies navigation.


The application can record tracks while being in the background (on many devices, this requires additional configuration in the system - be careful! The instructions for these settings are available in the application). Power consumption in background mode is greatly optimized - on average, the phone's charge is enough for a whole day of recording. There's also an economy mode - you can turn it on in the app settings.


Geo Tracker calculates the following statistics:
• Distance traveled and recording time;
• Max and average speed on the track;
• Time and average speed in motion;
• Min and max altitude on the track, altitude difference;
• Vertical distance, ascent and speed;
• Min, max, and average slope.


Also, there are detailed charts of speed and elevation data available.


Recorded tracks can be stored as GPX, KML, and KMZ files, so they can be used in other well-known applications like Google Earth or Ozi Explorer. Tracks are stored locally on your device and are not transferred to any servers.


The app does not make money from ads or your personal data. To support the development of the project, a voluntary donation can be made in the application.


Useful tips & tricks to solve common GPS issues with your smartphone:
• If you start the tracking please wait a bit until the GPS signal is found.
• Restart your smartphone and make sure that you have a "clear view" of the sky before you start (no disturbing objects like high buildings, forests, etc.).
• The reception conditions are permanently changing because they are influenced by the following factors: weather, season, positioning of satellites, areas with bad GPS coverage, high buildings, forests, etc.).
• Go to phone settings, choose "Location" and activate it.
• Go to phone settings, choose "Date & time" and activate the following options: "Automatic date & time" and "Automatic time zone". It may occur that it takes longer until the GPS signal is found if your smartphone is set to the wrong time zone.
• Deactivate the airplane mode in your phone settings.


If none of these tips & tricks helped to solve your issues, deinstall the app and reinstall it again.
Be aware that Google uses in their Google Maps app not only the GPS data but also additional data of the current location from surrounding WLAN networks and/or mobile networks.


More answers to frequent questions and solutions for popular issues can be found on the website: https://geo-tracker.org/faq/?lang=en

description:
Track your miles. Keep your deduction. No account, no signup, no email.

TripTally is a mileage and expense tracker for people who drive for a living - Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Instacart, Grubhub, Amazon Flex, Shipt and more. It is built by one developer who drives too.

HOW THE FREE TRIAL WORKS - PLEASE READ THIS FIRST

When you install TripTally you get 14 days of Pro. You do not enter a credit card. You do not create an account or hand over an email address. Nothing gets charged automatically, because there is nothing on file to charge.

On day 15 the trial ends and the app does not lock you out. Mileage, earnings, expenses, the tax centre and CSV export all keep working, free, for as long as you want them.

What the free tier gives up: you see the last 30 days of records instead of your whole history, and the Pro features below switch off. Nothing is deleted. Older records stay on your phone and reappear in full the moment Pro is active, and backup and restore always cover everything, so you can never lose data you can't currently see.

Pro adds PDF tax reports, Bluetooth auto-trip (trips start and stop when your car connects), receipt scanning, recurring expenses, advanced insights and unlimited history.

THE 2026 MID-YEAR IRS RATE CHANGE, HANDLED

The IRS raised the business standard mileage rate partway through 2026: 72.5 cents a mile through June 30, then 76 cents from July 1. If you drove across that date your deduction uses both rates.

TripTally prices every trip at the rate for the date you actually drove it, so a split year needs no manual math. Older rates back to 2022 are built in, which keeps imported history correct too.

THE OVERLAY - CHECK TRACKING WITHOUT LEAVING YOUR NAV APP

TripTally can show a floating bubble on top of whatever you are already using. Waze, Google Maps, your driver app. You can see that tracking is running, on the screen you are already looking at, without switching apps mid-route.

That matters because of how mileage apps lose you money. They do not fail loudly. You find out in April that a whole shift never recorded.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE

There is no TripTally account, because there are no TripTally servers holding your trips. Your earnings, expenses and mileage live in storage on your own device.

A few things can reach the network and each one is your choice. Trip routes are drawn offline as a sketch by default; real map tiles load only if you turn them on, and the app tells you first that doing so asks OpenStreetMap for tiles. Backup to Google Drive runs only when you start it. Subscription billing goes through Google Play. Feedback you send comes to us — and if it can't get through, the app tells you and offers to email it instead. That is the list.

WHAT YOU GET

- Mileage log priced at the IRS rate for each trip's own date
- Earnings by platform, with tips, $/hour and $/mile
- Expenses in 10 categories: fuel, vehicle, phone, tolls, parking and more
- Floating overlay over navigation and driver apps
- CSV export with date, miles, route, business purpose and deduction
- Backup to a file, Google Drive or your Downloads folder
- No account, no signup, no email address
- 14-day Pro trial with no credit card

WHO IT IS FOR

Uber and Lyft drivers. DoorDash, Instacart, Grubhub, Amazon Flex and Shipt couriers and shoppers. Anyone self-employed who needs a mileage log that holds up at tax time and would rather not hand their driving history to a company to get it.

Track work hours, projects, and billable time in one place. Clockify is a time tracking and timesheet app used by individuals, teams, and businesses to track work, manage projects, and understand how time is spent. Start the timer, fill out timesheets, and generate reports with a free plan.

Clockify works for small businesses, agencies, and larger teams that want a clear insight into how work time is spent.

SIMPLE TIME TRACKING
Track work hours with a timer or log time manually.
- Start and stop the timer as you work
- Enter hours manually when needed
- Continue tracking previous activities with one click
- Track time across projects and tasks

TIMESHEETS AND WORK HOURS
Log your weekly activities in a clear timesheet view.
- Fill out timesheets quickly
- Reuse common activities with templates
- See total hours per day, project, or task
- Submit timesheets for approval

PROJECT AND BILLABLE TIME TRACKING
Track how much time is spent on projects and clients.
- Assign time entries to projects
- Mark hours as billable or non-billable
- Track project progress and costs
- Calculate earnings based on hourly rates

REPORTS AND INSIGHTS
Understand where your time goes with detailed reports.
- Get summary and detailed reports
- Generate weekly and team reports
- Filter by project, user, or date
- Export reports to PDF, CSV, or Excel

WORK FROM ANYWHERE
Track time across devices and platforms. Clockify works on:
- Mobile
- Desktop
- Web
You can also use it via a browser extension.

FREE PLAN AVAILABLE
Clockify offers a FREE plan that includes:
- Unlimited projects
- Time tracking with timer and timesheets
- Reporting

ADVANCED FEATURES FOR TEAMS
Organizations that need additional management and control can benefit from advanced capabilities, such as:
- Billable rates
- Scheduling and team capacity planning
- Time off tracking and approvals
- Expense tracking
- Invoicing for billable work
- Screenshots and GPS tracking
- Team roles and permissions

Download the app and create an account for free, or log in using your existing details.

name: Timesheet - Work Time Tracker
description:

Excel and CSV Export
- Build invoice-ready and payroll-ready reports in seconds
- Pick a preset or a custom date range before exporting
- Share by email, Google Drive or any other business tool

Statistics
- See time and income per day, week, month or project

Automations
- Geofence automation starts or stops the timer when you arrive or leave
- Wi-Fi automation reacts to the network at your workplace
- NFC tags at a job site switch straight to the right project

Widget and Wear OS
- Start, pause and stop from the home screen widget
- Control the timer from your wrist with the Wear OS tile

Backup and Restore
- Back up to Google Drive, Dropbox or local storage
- Restore your full history on a new device in a few steps

Built for freelancers, contractors, tradespeople, consultants and anyone who is paid for their time or has to account for it.

Free and paid plans

Time tracking, projects, statistics, breaks, expenses, exports and automations are free, with no account and no time limit.

Support

name: LogBook - Mileage Tracker
description:
LogBook is the simple, private mileage log book app built for sole traders, freelancers, and small business owners. Track your business and personal vehicle trips, calculate your claimable amount using your mileage rates, and export professional PDF or CSV reports for your accountant — all from your phone.

⭐ WHY LOGBOOK?

Keeping a mileage logbook shouldn't be complicated. LogBook makes it fast and effortless to record every business trip so you never miss a deduction at tax time. No GPS tracking, no battery drain, no cloud accounts — just a clean, intuitive logbook that respects your privacy.

✅ LOG TRIPS IN SECONDS

Tap, enter your route and distance, and you're done. Categorise each trip as business or personal. Add a purpose note for your records. Use the date selector to log past trips you forgot. Your logbook stays organised with trips grouped by date and easy filtering options.

📊 AUTOMATIC MILEAGE CALCULATIONS

LogBook calculates your claimable amount automatically using the mileage rates you enter. Supports tiered rate systems where the first portion of kilometres or miles is claimed at a higher rate and additional kilometres or miles at a lower rate. Update your rates each year when new ones are published — your historical trips keep their original rates. See your total business kilometres or miles, trip count, and claimable amount at a glance on your dashboard.

📄 PROFESSIONAL PDF & CSV REPORTS

Export a detailed mileage report as a PDF or CSV file and share it directly with your accountant. Reports include trip dates, routes, distances, purposes, vehicle details, and calculated claims. Choose your reporting period — current month, current year, full financial year, or a custom date range. Reports are generated entirely on your device and are ready for tax filing.

🚗 MULTIPLE VEHICLES

Track mileage across multiple vehicles, each with its own fuel type, mileage rate, and photo. Supports petrol, diesel, hybrid, and electric vehicles with separate rates for each. Set a primary vehicle for quick trip logging. Archive old vehicles while keeping their history intact.

🌍 BUILT FOR YOUR COUNTRY

LogBook is configured for New Zealand, Australia, United Kingdom, United States, and Canada. Each country has its own currency, distance unit, and financial year pre-configured. Enter your current mileage rates during setup — this way your logbook always uses the correct rates even when they change each year.

🔒 100% PRIVATE — YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE

LogBook stores all your data locally on your phone. No account required. No cloud sync. No GPS tracking. No ads. Your mileage records never leave your device unless you choose to export or share a report. Back up and restore your data at any time using the built-in backup feature.

💰 SIMPLE PRICING

Start free with 15 trips per month and 1 vehicle. Unlock unlimited trips, unlimited vehicles, and all features with a single one-time purchase — no subscription, no recurring charges, no hidden fees. Pay once, use forever.

🎯 PERFECT FOR:

Sole traders and self-employed professionals who need a mileage log book for tax deductions. Freelancers and contractors tracking business travel. Small business owners managing vehicle expenses. Delivery drivers, sales reps, consultants, tradespeople, and anyone who drives for work. Employees claiming mileage reimbursement from their employer.

🔧 KEY FEATURES:

Quick trip logging with business/personal categories. Automatic mileage rate calculations with tiered rates. PDF and CSV report export. Multiple vehicle support with photos. Dashboard with total km/miles, trips, and claimable amount. Financial year awareness with custom date ranges. Dark mode. Backup and restore. Works offline — no internet required. One-time purchase — no subscription.

Download LogBook today and take control of your mileage tracking. Stop losing deductions. Start logging trips.

* * Features **

** OBDII **
TripTracker is able to connect directly to your car so that it can read the odometer and calculate the distance traveled. This allows TripTracker to write your mileage logbook 100% synchronized with your car. In addition, various parameters and the error memory can be read.
To use this feature, you don’t need to modify your car! You just require a Bluetooth adapter which is plugged in to the cars OBDII interface. Installation is very easy since in most modern cars the OBDII interface is directly beneath the steering wheel.
For more information please read here: https://triptracker.app/obdii
NOTE: Wifi Adapters are not supported anymore due to some Android limitations.


** Security **
TripTracker provides complete and correct data collection. The mileage logbook’s integrity is ensured by various hash and encryption algorithm. Each entry has its own checksum to guarantee that it isn't changed afterwards or outside of TripTracker. The generated PDF can be signed by one of our servers to ensure that it can't be modified.

** Privacy **
In contrary to most other systems all the collected data is your property. It is not stored somewhere abroad on a Server or a Cloud. The mileage logbook is on your phone in a local high performance SQL database.
TripTracker does not sell or analyze your mileage logbook!!

** Backend **
TripTracker has a powerful synchronization mechanism that allows you to collect and edit your mileage logbook across multiple devices. There is also a web interface which allows you to analyze your data on a PC or Mac.

description:
Travel Logs is an extremely easy and effective way to track your trips for all of your vehicles. It is the next generation vehicle mileage logbook. With a streamlined information-entry user interface and, the added option of using GPS to auto-fill in location information – you don’t need the paper version any more!

Logging information for a trip has never been so easy thanks to the GPS auto-fill feature that will automatically fill in your location, with a press of a button, and calculates the distance traveled using the GPS of your device. This makes tracking your trips all the more simple, less time-consuming and less stressful!

Key Features
◦ ATO Compliant
◦ Multiple Vehicles.
◦ Bluetooth hands-free device support for automatic trip start and stop.
◦ Log trip details (odometer, date, purpose, type, location, vehicle).
◦ Exporting of log reports in CSV and PDF format.
◦ Automatic start and stop of trips for assigned places.
◦ Use of GPS to auto-fill in location information and calculate distance traveled for each trip.
◦ Route recording.
◦ Vehicle expense tracking.
◦ Vehicle maintenance tracking.

GPS – Location Auto-fill and Tracking
Travel Logs has the option to allow you to use the GPS feature in your device to determine your current and/or end location. This will give you the option to auto-fill in the location details for your logs and also estimate the distance traveled so you won’t have to fill in the end odometer values!

There is also an option to use realtime GPS tracking, which track your distance traveled accurately instead of just estimating.

Bluetooth Hands-Free Support
Assign bluetooth devices for each vehicle and have Travel Logs automatically start and stop your trips when you connect and disconnect from the hands-free device.

Places
A place can be your home, work or frequent client address. Travel Logs can automatically start and end trips when you depart or arrive at an assigned place.

Route Recording
When using realtime GPS tracking, you can record the route you took for that trip. When viewing past trips, the route will be plotted on the map so you can see where you went, down to each individual street you took.

Log Reports
The log reports are in Comma Separated Value (CSV) format, so you can import and open in any of your favourite spreadsheet applications. (Excel, Numbers, etc)

This app complies with the Australian Tax Office (ATO) logbook format. It will calculate the percentage of business use for each vehicle and total business distance in the exported log reports.

The log reports include total distance traveled, the starting and ending odometer values, date/time, purpose of trip, trip type, location from start to finish, driver name, vehicle and registration number.

Vehicle Expense Tracking
Track the expense and credits for each of your vehicles.

Vehicle Maintenance and Service Record Logging
Keep track of each of your vehicles maintenance and service records.

name: Truck Weight Calculator
description:
Truck Weight Calculator helps you slide tandems, estimate axle weights, and stay legal—fast.
Using a platform and cat scale has never been easier. You can offset scale readings and weighing in or out of the scale.

Sliding trailer axles to the right hole eliminates guesswork and saves time and money on re-weighing. You can specify your load arrangement and weight distribution to make axle slide calculations more precise.
This helps ensure compliance at truck weigh stations, reduces the risk of overweight fines, and gives you peace of mind before rolling in. Think of it as your backup plan—built to keep you safe, legal, and confident on the road.

If you're overweight on an axle, the app helps you fix it—when possible. That might mean sliding axles to the right hole, burning off excess fuel before reaching the weigh station, adjusting the fifth wheel, or simply knowing your state’s weight regulations.

Estimating axle weight is a premium feature that lets you calculate axle weights before you even reach the scale. The app uses the gross weight of the load (payload) from your Bill of Lading and your load arrangement to make accurate predictions. It’s useful in all kinds of everyday trucking scenarios.

If there’s no scale nearby, you can set your axles in the hole with the highest chance of being compliant—no guessing required. You’ll get a calculated solution that gives you peace of mind, especially when hauling lighter loads and unsure if scaling is necessary. The estimator helps you analyze different scenarios and pick the safest hole.
Plus, you can spot load arrangement issues ahead of time—while you're still being loaded.

Whether you're hauling pallets or equipment, Truck Weight Calculator helps you stay legal, save time, and optimize your load. Core features are free, and premium tools are available via in-app purchase.

Truck Weight Calculator supports 53' (16m) and 48' (14.6m) trailers (cooler, dry-van, flatbed) with 2–3 axles and axle splits up to 11'6". While designed for palletized loads, it can also provide rough estimates for equipment on flatbeds—making it a versatile truck axle weight calculator for real-world scenarios.

Built for drivers, by those who understand the road. Whether you're scaling, planning, or adjusting on the fly, Truck Weight Calculator keeps you compliant, confident, and moving forward.

Features:

name: Organic Maps・Offline Map & GPS
description:
Organic Maps is a fast, detailed offline map and GPS navigation app for travel, hiking, trekking, and cycling adventures. Plan, import, and record routes, and enjoy smooth guidance without draining your battery or using an internet connection. Explore places and navigate safely during your outdoor adventures and travels around the world. The app offers unlimited map downloads and biweekly updates. OpenStreetMap-based, volunteer-made, privacy-first, 100% offline, and 100% free.

OFFLINE: The app works 100% offline — including search and navigation. You can explore the map and navigate without an internet connection, saving on mobile data and roaming fees. And with no background data transfers, your battery lasts much longer.

FAST: Zooming, search, and route calculations work noticeably fast.

DETAILED & UPDATED: The maps are rich in detail and refreshed twice a month to reflect real-world conditions. Unlike many well-known competitors, they include building labels, benches, hiking paths, and other helpful information.

OPENSTREETMAP-BASED: OpenStreetMap is a wiki-style world map built and maintained by millions of volunteers — locals who know their areas best. This community effort results in highly detailed maps, often more accurate than commercial ones in less-mapped regions. Organic Maps updates its data from OpenStreetMap every two weeks, keeping your maps fresh and reliable. And if you notice something missing, you can add it to OpenStreetMap and help improve the map for everyone.

PRIVACY-FIRST: We don’t collect any data or identifiers. This means there’s no risk of data leaks and no distractions like ads or noisy notifications — just a clean, private map experience.

IMPORTANT FEATURES

EXPLORE PLACES: Search by address, name, or category, discover millions of POIs, and view detailed information such as opening hours, Wikipedia articles, wheelchair accessibility, and other helpful details.

GPS NAVIGATION: Enjoy voice-guided, turn-by-turn directions. Create walking, hiking, cycling, or driving routes — including routes between cities, countries, and multiple waypoints. Find the best routes for your metro journeys and commutes. Android Auto is supported.

HIKING & CYCLING TRAILS FROM AROUND THE WORLD: Enable special map layers to discover popular hiking and cycling routes worldwide, all sourced from OpenStreetMap. Switch between layers to see colored bike and MTB routes, as well as official hiking paths.

PUBLIC TRANSPORT: See public transport route numbers at stops. Live transport schedules and routing are currently in development.

MAP STYLES: Choose map layers that fit your activity — Outdoors, Contour Lines, Hiking, Cycling, or Metro/Subway.

TRACK RECORDER: Record, import, export, and share your routes and favorite places. Supports KML, KMZ, GPX, and GeoJSON formats.

WIKIPEDIA ARTICLES: Explore Wikipedia articles for places you discover on the map. Type “?wiki” in the search to find all places with Wikipedia articles.

MAP EDITOR: Contribute to OpenStreetMap by adding missing places or editing the map directly from Organic Maps.

DARK MODE: Switch to a dark theme for comfortable viewing at night.

Try the app — it’s 100% free, ad-free, fast, and fully offline. Experience reliable GPS navigation for hiking, biking, trekking, and travel anywhere in the world! Enjoy a fast, reliable, and private map experience, and share it with others!

Organic Maps is an indie, community-driven, open-source project with hundreds of contributors who help develop new features, fix issues, translate, and move the project forward.

name: Drivers' Hours: HGV & Van
description:
Plan your day against EU 561/2006 drivers' hours and UK Working Time (RTD 2005) rules — in real time, on your phone, with no subscription.

Built for both classic HGV work and the newer 2.5–3.5t international vans now in scope with a tachograph. If you're a courier or delivery driver touching a tacho for the first time, this gives you the same live timers, warnings and correction flow HGV drivers already rely on.

Tap Driving, Rest, Other work or Availability and Drivers' Hours does the maths:

- Countdown to your next 45-minute break (4h30 continuous driving), with 15+30 split breaks handled in the correct order.
- Daily driving left — 9 hours, or 10 hours on your two allowed days a week.
- This week (56h) and rolling two-week (90h) driving left.
- Daily rest and weekly rest deadlines (the 6 x 24-hour rule), counting down.
- Working Time (WTD) hours this week against the 60-hour individual-week limit, with cumulative break reminders (30 min after 6h, 45 min after 9h).
- A 17-week rolling WTD average against the 48-hour limit — most apps don't track this at all.
- Clear amber and red warnings before you run out — plus optional reminders that fire even when the app is closed.

Built for UK drivers: dd/mm/yyyy dates, a 24-hour clock and plain English — not the American mm/dd that other apps get wrong.

Forgot to switch mode? Every change is a single tap to correct on the timeline.

No subscription. A one-off purchase removes ads and unlocks PDF and CSV export of your log. Live status, timers and reminders are always free.

Your driving log stays on your device — no account, no cloud, no card reader, no tachograph download. (The free tier shows ads, which use an advertising identifier.)

Important — please read
This app is a planning aid, not the legal record. Your digital tachograph card and the data downloaded from it remain the only official record of your hours. Figures here are estimates from what you enter and can differ from the tacho analysis. The Working Time 48-hour figure is a rolling average over your last 17 recorded weeks; your employer's fixed reference period (17 weeks, or 26 by agreement) may differ, so treat it as a guide. Always check the tachograph.

For 2.5–3.5t vans: this app is for jobs that are actually in scope of EU 561/2006. It does not create an exemption and it does not replace the legal check on whether the van, route and carriage type require a tachograph.

FMCSA-compliant app to record driver duty status and meet the following regulations:
-60h/7days or 70h/8days Rules
-34 week restart with latest suspension of two periods 1-5am
-11h daily
-14h onduty (daily)
-Sleeper Berth
-Personal Conveyance
-30 minutes Break
-Location recording for engine on and off, and every 60 minutes if moving
-Mobile device permits duty status changes only when the vehicle is at rest
-Warns driver, visually and/or audibly of any malfunction
-When the truck is stationary for 5 minutes or more, it will default to on-duty not driving and the driver must enter the proper status
-The device (ELD) performs self-test, as well as a self-test at any point upon request of an authorized safety assurance official.

Allows for driver and carrier record edits as well as unauthenticated operation.
Support for Hours of Service September 29th 2020 Hours of Service regulation changes added.

name: Jolly Classroom
description:
Make Teaching Phonics & Grammar Easy with Jolly Classroom!
Jolly Classroom is a comprehensive, interactive classroom app designed to support teachers in delivering systematic phonemic awareness, spelling, grammar and punctuation lessons with ease. With over 150 structured lessons, engaging activities and built-in phonics assessments, this app ensures that students develop strong reading and writing skills in a fun and research-backed way.

A Complete Classroom Solution
Jolly Classroom provides a structured, step-by-step approach to teaching phonics, grammar and spelling. Aligned with the Science of Reading, the app focuses on building essential phonemic awareness, reading fluency and writing accuracy in a way that is engaging and easy to follow.

What is Jolly Phonics?
Jolly Phonics is a programme for teaching reading and writing. It is based on a systematic synthetic phonics approach and was developed by teachers Sue Lloyd and Sara Wernham. It is the first stage in teaching children to read and write using the 5 key skills. It focuses on direct, explicit instruction of phonemic awareness and phonics for both reading (decoding) and writing (encoding). Scientific research has consistently shown phonemic awareness to be essential for building strong reading, spelling and writing skills.

Why Choose Jolly Classroom?
1. Phonics Programme – Bring phonemic awareness to your school with interactive activities and clear instructions
2. Spelling, Grammar & Punctuation – Course introducing complex concepts of English Grammar in a fun and easy way
3. Built-in Phonics Assessments – Includes Jolly Phonics assessments and phonics screening tests to track student progress
4. Teacher-Friendly – Simple school setup with customisable staff and student profiles
5. Multi-Sensory Learning – Animated guidance, blending & segmenting tools and audio support make learning engaging for all students
6. British & American English Options – Tailor your teaching experience to suit different curriculums

Key Features That Make Learning Effective
1. Phonics Lessons - Step-by-step systematic phonics instruction, including 72 tricky words, helping children learn to read and write confidently
2. Spelling, Grammar & Punctuation - Develop core English skills with structured lessons designed for classroom success
3. Phonics Assessments - built-in phonics assessments that help a school track student progress and prepare effectively for the Phonics Screening Check
4. Interactive Activities - Fun animations and audio support for letter formation, blending and segmenting
5. Progress Tracking - Monitor individual and class performance

Who Is Jolly Classroom For?
1. School – A curriculum-aligned solution for developing reading and writing skills
2. Teachers – A powerful classroom resource for structured phonics and grammar instruction
3. Pupils – Designed for early learners to master phonics, spelling and grammar through interactive lessons
4. Homeschool – An excellent tool for homeschool parents teaching their children at home with a structured, easy-to-follow program

Jolly Classroom is also an excellent resource for English learners, providing a structured and engaging way to build phonemic awareness, reading fluency and English grammar proficiency. With its systematic approach to teaching letter sounds, blending and sentence formation, the app helps English as a Second Language (ESL) students develop confidence in reading and writing. The interactive lessons and audio-supported activities ensure that learners can hear correct pronunciation, practice spelling and improve their understanding of grammar and sentence structure in an accessible way. Whether in a school or a homeschool setting, Jolly Classroom makes mastering English grammar and phonics easy!

Transform Your Classroom Today!
Join thousands of educators using Jolly Classroom to teach phonics, spelling and grammar with confidence.

Download now and bring phonics lessons into your school!

Key Features:

Flexible Weighting and Columns
Set up customized evaluations such as assignments, homework, quizzes, midterms, and final exams. Define the maximum possible marks for each evaluation and customize weight configurations (including partial-weight distributions) to match your curriculum requirements.

Excel-Style Grading Formulas
Take control of letter grade assignments using nested IF formulas. You can input customized grade scale thresholds directly into the system to automate letter grade calculations based on your school’s unique grading framework.

Efficient Mark Entry and Fast Grading
Input records quickly using a streamlined interface. The rapid-grade entry mode displays your roster sequentially with specialized sliders, allowing you to quickly save grades for a large student cohort in a single session.

Dynamic Grade Curving
Apply statistical curves directly to classroom marks. Utilize flat boost increments clamped to the total possible weight, or use scaled curving proportional to the highest-scoring student to balance class score distributions automatically.

Detailed Class Analytics
Understand cohort performance instantly with automated statistical visualizations. Access class averages, pass rates, highest and lowest scores, letter grade distributions, student performance lists, and highlighted rosters of cohorts requiring academic support.

Strict Local Privacy and Security
Your student data belongs to you. Student Gradebook for Teachers operates with zero network requirements and zero data collection. All rosters, classes, marks, and formulas are securely stored locally inside an encrypted sandbox database on your mobile device.

Local Backup
Export class lists or share data across devices using local JSON backups. All backup and share processes are executed locally using standard secure device framework protocols.

name: Planit: Photo Planner
description:
In this free version, the Ephemeris feature is provided as an in-app purchase. After the purchase, it will be the same as the paid PlanIt Pro. Some screenshots listed here have Ephemeris features enabled. The free version can actually do a lot of things than you thought. It is a plan/marker file reader, a focal length estimator on the map, a DoF and panorama calculator and can even preview the aerial view for your drone. The Ephemeris feature is so highly integrated that it is hard for us to provide some of them in the free version and ask you to pay for the rest. You can see how many users give us a one-star rating simply because we didn't provide a trial. I think that's not fair. But as we said, although we didn't provide a trial, please feel free to purchase to try it. We can refund you at any time if you don't like it.

Please email info@planitphoto.com for bug reports or feature requests. Please also remember to visit https://youtu.be/JFpSi1u0-is for more video tutorials. Each video only lasts a few minutes but you will sure learn a lot from them. You can also reach us through Instagram or Facebook. Links are under the menu inside the app.

This is a special call to landscape photographers, travel photographers, nature photographers and those who are interested in night photography, city photography, time-lapse, star-trails, milky way or astro-photography: look no more, this is the ultimate app for you - the Planit Pro. It only costs you a cup of Frappuccino but will save you tons of time and effort and a lot of gas money. Most importantly, it will make you enjoying landscape photography even more.

Ansel Adams dedicates the beginning of his first book "Taos Pueblo" to visualization. He introduced the idea of "previsualization", which involved the photographer imagining what he wanted his final print to look like before he even took the shot. Of course, there are many great photos which were taken impromptu. However, for landscape photographers, being able to previsualize the scene before going there will greatly reduce the chance of being caught unprepared and will greatly increase the chance of getting better shots.

Photographers use various tools to help them pre-visualizing the scene. Nowadays, many of those tools are phone apps. Planit Pro is an all-in-one solution that is designed to leverage the map and simulated viewfinder technologies to provide the necessary tools for photographers to pre-visualize the scene in combination with the ground subjects and the celestial objects such as the Sun, the Moon, Stars, Star-trails and Milky Way.

In the Planit Pro app, we packed it with features - from location scouting such as GPS coordinates, elevations, distance, elevation gain, clear view, focal length, depth of field (DoF), hyperfocal distance, panorama and aerial photography, to the Ephemeris features such as the sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset time and direction, twilight time, special hours of the day, sun/moon finder, major stars, constellations, nebulae azimuth and elevation angle, star trail planning, time-lapse calculation and simulation, sequence calculation and simulation, milky way searching, solar eclipse and lunar eclipse, exposure/ND filter calculator, light meter, rainbow position prediction, tide height and tide search etc. All the information are either represented on the map as an overlay or visually presented in simulated viewfinders (VR, AR, picture, or street view), just like you look through your camera's viewfinder. Whatever you want for your landscape photography, it is there in the Planit Pro.

Landscape photography is an adventure in the nature world. We understand sometimes there won't be any network connection when you are out exploring. Planit Pro was designed for have it in mind. If you preload the offline elevation files and the offline mbtiles maps, you can use the app fully offline without the need for network connections.

name: Shoot Planner: Photo Shot List
description:
Plan the shoot before the shoot. Shoot Planner is a photo shoot planner and shot list app for photographers and filmmakers — and every part of it works offline.

Most tools do one thing: a moodboard, or a shot list, or a sun calculator. Shoot Planner chains them into one pipeline — references to shots to locations to lighting to storyboard to gear — then follows you into the field on the day.

WORKS WITH NO SIGNAL
The golden hour engine and the field mode are fully on-device. No signal on a canyon rim, in a basement venue, or on a plane means nothing to this app. Your shoot day does not depend on a login screen loading.

SHOT LIST
Build a shot list with priorities, descriptions, focal length and camera notes. Assign shots to a day, drag to reorder, and mark each one captured as you go.

REFERENCES AND MOODBOARD
Collect a visual moodboard per project — shoot with the camera, pull from your photo library, or paste a Pinterest, Instagram or web link and the image and title are fetched for you. Browse it as a masonry gallery and filter by tag.

REFERENCE TO SHOT, IN ONE TAP
Turn any reference into a shot, permanently linked. On set you see the inspiration image beside the shot you are taking — not buried in a different app on a different tab.

GOLDEN HOUR AND BLUE HOUR
An offline solar engine gives sunrise, sunset, the golden hour window with its exact duration, blue hour, and the sun path for every day and location in your plan. No network, no subscription wall, no waiting for a map tile.

LOCATION SCOUTING AND MAP
Geo-tag each shot and see the whole project as numbered pins in shooting order. Save access notes — parking, gate codes, permit restrictions, the walk in — and hand off to your maps app for directions.

STORYBOARD
Lay scenes out as horizontal filmstrips, drag to sequence them, and set per-shot durations with realistic travel and setup gaps between them. See whether the day actually fits before you promise it.

GEAR LIBRARY AND PACKING LIST
Keep a reusable inventory of bodies, lenses, support, power, filters and drone kit. Build a packing list per project and watch the packed progress climb. Stop arriving without the one lens the shot needed.

SHOOT MODE
The reason this is not just another planning document. One-handed, one shot at a time: the current shot with its reference image, a live golden hour countdown, a big capture button, skip and advance, and a place for on-set notes. The screen stays awake. It runs entirely offline and syncs when you are back in service.

TEMPLATES AND REMINDERS
Save any project as a template and reuse it, or start from Wedding Essentials, Location Scout or Brand Day. Set shoot-relative reminders — pack gear two hours before call — and push shoot days to your device, Google or Apple calendar.

WHO IT IS FOR
Wedding, portrait, landscape, brand and commercial photographers. Videographers and filmmakers running their own film pre-production. Solo shooters who plan properly and want the plan in their hand on the day.

BUILT FOR THE WAY SHOOT DAYS ACTUALLY GO
Your shooting schedule slips because the light moved, the location was gated, or the client added a setup. Shoot Planner is built to be edited on the day, not admired the night before. Reorder the shot list in the field, re-check the sunrise and sunset times for the new spot, mark the shots you got, and keep the photo shoot checklist honest as the day changes around you.

PRICING
Free to use, with a capped number of projects. Pro unlocks unlimited projects at $6.99/month or $59.99/year — around 28% off annually — and starts with a 7-day free trial.

Shoot Planner is a photo shoot planner, shot list app, photography planner, storyboard tool, location scouting notebook, camera gear checklist and golden hour calculator — the whole shoot day pre-production workflow in one offline app.

Download Shoot Planner and walk onto your next shoot knowing exactly what you came for.

Add value to your site records. Tag, describe and categorize photos as you capture them to ease reference, search and reporting. Photos that your team adds are synced online and instantly accessible on the computer via the SiteCam web app.

Turn a selection of your site records into a detailed photo report in minutes, not hours. Photos in SiteCam can be sent to our report template, ready to edit, share via a URL, or download as a PDF. Reports include photo locations on your plans, GPS information, timestamps and your notes.


View your team’s photos by location, using map or plan views, or scroll through the gallery. You can search through photos by date, tags, record type, description text, and more. The AI search within the app allows you to search using the contents of a photo that has been analyzed and auto-tagged.

Capture construction defects or snags, with markups and descriptions of what needs to be done. Pin each defect to the plan to show exactly where work is needed, all clearly shown in your report. Add update photos to a pin to record evidence of how an issue has been fixed.

What is SiteCam good at?
Creating a centralized construction photo database for your team, instead of everyone having their own system.
Showing the location of your photos on a plan and map
Helping you show before, during, and after update photos in a location through time
Producing better records with timestamped and GPS-stamped photos

Streamlining work from field to office with mobile and web platforms.

Helping you create a photo organization system that matches your project structure

name: PlanIt Earth: VR Photo Planner
description:
For landscape, travel, nature, city, night, time-lapse, star-trail, Milky Way and astro photographers: PlanIt Earth builds on everything we learned from PlanIt Pro and takes previsualization to a new level.

Ansel Adams called it previsualization: imagining the final print before the shot is taken. Seeing a scene before you travel greatly raises the odds of coming home with the photo you wanted. PlanIt Earth is built around that one idea: see the shot before you go.

What sets it apart is the photorealistic VR viewfinder. Instead of reading numbers on a map, you stand at your camera position and see the real terrain, built from satellite imagery and elevation data, with the Sun, Moon, Milky Way, stars, clouds, 3D markers and your framing where they will be. Scrub time and watch light and shadows move through your composition.

There isn't always a signal in the field. Preload offline elevation, maps and markers and keep scouting and planning offline.

Plan the light. Preview the scene. Arrive ready.

**FEATURES**

**Photorealistic VR planning**
- Real terrain and horizon rendered from elevation data and satellite imagery
- Photoreal city backgrounds with Google 3D Tiles, plus Street View and your own photos
- Aim with camera and scene pins; focal length, angle of view and line of sight
- Live depth-of-field and bokeh preview: see the blur, not numbers
- Aerial and drone view, immersive full screen, and an AR viewfinder for framing on site

**Sun, Moon, Milky Way and sky**
- Sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset, golden hour, blue hour, twilight and astronomical darkness
- Sun and Moon direction, altitude, paths and alignment timing
- Milky Way Center direction, visibility and realistic sky placement, with Milky Way Seeker for the best dates and locations
- Stars, planets, constellations, meteor showers, comets, eclipses, rainbows and moonbows
- The Sun drawn from a time-matched NASA SDO image at its true apparent size

**Alignment and shoot planning**
- Find where and when the Sun or Moon lines up with your subject
- Search the sky across years for the conditions you want
- Plan sequences, multi-day shoots and time-lapses on a key-frame timeline
- Exposure guides for eclipses, star trails, the Milky Way and more
- Smart auto shooting fires your camera at the planned moment
- Measure distance, height, elevation and two-station geometry

**Map-based scouting**
- Full-screen planning map with camera and scene pins and direction lines
- Multiple map providers and layers, terrain, light-pollution and aurora overlays
- Search locations, save markers and 3D models, record and import tracks
- Offline regions: map, elevation and markers downloaded for the field

**Weather and field conditions**
- Photographer-focused weather and forecast cards
- Cloud, visibility, fog, wind, humidity, frost, dust and other shooting conditions
- Aurora forecasts, solar activity, space-weather alerts, tides and waves
- ISS and satellite passes, aircraft transits and rocket launches, with a transit alarm

**Telescope rig control**
- Drive an equatorial mount, focuser and astronomy camera from the phone over Wi-Fi or USB, or through the SharpCap bridge on a PC
- Still being finished: many models are untested against real hardware, so check with your own gear

**Plans, markers and tracks**
- Save complete plans with map position, pins, time and shooting setup, grouped into folders by trip, subject or place
- Sign in with your PlanIt account to sync plans, markers, tracks and settings across devices

**PlanIt+**
PlanIt Earth is free to explore. PlanIt+ unlocks the photorealistic VR viewfinder, the night, time-lapse, alignment, aerospace and weather modules, and offline regions, as an auto-renewable annual subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Coming from PlanIt Pro? Your past purchases become credit toward PlanIt+.

Memories
Save and organize your life by stages: family, partner, children, friends, trips, pets or any special moment. Add photos, videos, texts and memories to build a private, shared and easy-to-relive story.

Create shared albums for weddings, birthdays, celebrations and unique moments. Invite family, friends or guests so everyone can upload photos and videos in one place.

Physical Dotbook
Turn your best memories into a tangible, beautiful and long-lasting book. Each physical Dotbook can include printed photos, texts, dates, videos and voice messages accessible via QR to watch and listen to them again whenever you want.

Digital Dotbook
Create a digital version of your story, organized and ready to save, share or export as PDF. Ideal if you want to preserve your memories now and decide later if you want to print them.

Dots doesn't exist just to store images.

It exists so important stories don't disappear.

With Dots you can:
- Save photos and videos in a private and secure space
- Share memories with family, partner, friends or guests
- Create albums for weddings, birthdays and events
- Organize your story by stages and important moments
- Create a physical Dotbook with your best memories
- Create a digital Dotbook in PDF
- Add videos and voice messages via QR
- Relive memories through photos, videos, voices and messages
- Keep your story organized, accessible and shared

Photos remind you what a moment was like.
Videos take you back to it.
And Dotbook turns your story into something you can keep forever.

description:
Shot Designer is a ground-breaking tool for Directors and DPs that creates Animated Camera Diagrams, with integrated Shot List, Storyboards, Professional Director's Viewfinder, and Sync & Team Sharing via the Hollywood Camera Work cloud at no extra cost.

WHAT IS SHOT DESIGNER?

• CAMERA DIAGRAM - Shot Designer dramatically speeds up the Director's process of making camera diagrams. Create full-blown diagrams in minutes. The software does most of the work.
• ANIMATION - Animate your characters and cameras to move around your diagram in real-time. Previsualize the rhythm of a scene by seeing it play out.
• SHOT LIST - The integrated Shot List is tied into the diagram and writes itself while you work. Edit shots intuitively in the diagram, not in a confusing spreadsheet.
• DIRECTOR'S VIEWFINDER / STORYBOARDS - Bring in lens-accurate camera angles via the integrated Director's Viewfinder or Storyboard Import.
• MAC/PC DESKTOP VERSION - An identical Mac/PC Desktop Version is included with the Pro Version (in-app upgrade).
• SYNC & TEAM SHARING VIA DROPBOX - Sync your scenes across all your devices. Share scene folders with teams. Control who owns which scene. (Pro Feature)

Watch the feature-demo at http://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/shot-designer-videos.html

CAMERA-BLOCKING ON STEROIDS

Shot Designer was developed by Per Holmes, the creator of the Hollywood Camera Work training.

Shot Designer is based on the realization that neither Camera Diagrams, Shot Lists, or Storyboards by themselves give you a satisfying understanding of camera-blocking -- you have to use them *together*.

Shot Designer is FAST. The app knows how Directing works and automatically does most of the work for you. Cameras rearrange themselves when you move characters. Animate characters and cameras with simple Walk To and Track To commands. Create sophisticated tracking shots with multiple marks. Shot Designer is fast enough that you can rearrange the diagram with actors waiting.

OTHER FEATURES

• Integrated Set Designer for building floor plans.
• Integrated Lighting Designer for DPs, with lighting symbols provided by Ari Golan of Atomic Imaging Studios Chicago.
• Import production drawings as backgrounds and block on top of them.
• Factory Templates of pre-made camera setups for any situation.
• Make your own templates as starting points for new scenes.
• Large and growing prop/furniture library. Email us requests, we'll build them.
• Scene Freeze: Experiment easily by taking snapshots you can return to (Pro).
• PDF/JPG/Excel export and emailing of Camera Diagrams and Shot Lists (Pro).
• Unlimited Folder Structure for organizing scenes (Pro).

The Free Version of Shot Designer is full-featured except for Save and Export. Your current scene is always saved, and you can be fully productive working on one scene at a time. The Pro Version (in-app upgrade) adds File Management, identical Mac/PC Desktop Version, PDF/JPG/Excel Export, Scene Freeze and more.

A real shot list in 30 seconds. Pick vlog, interview, wedding or short film and your scenes, shots and cast are written for you.

WRITE THE SCRIPT
Type scenes, action and dialogue in a clean mobile editor. Or say it out loud: talk a scene through and it comes back written as scenes and shots, because it hears wide, close-up and cut to while you speak. Already have a screenplay? Import a PDF or a Word file, or paste it in from Notes, and it is broken into scenes and shots for you. Ask the AI to rewrite a line, check a scene or write the next one, and see every change before you accept it.

BUILD THE SHOT LIST
Split the project into scenes, then scenes into shots. Set the size, the lens, the movement and the notes. Add b-roll cutaways under any shot, with suggestions when you are stuck. Reorder with a drag. Your list is always ready to shoot.

STORYBOARD IN 3D
Block a scene with a real camera. Place characters, choose the lens, set the angle and the framing, then save the frame as a shot. No drawing skills needed.

QUENTINO, YOUR AI SHOT COACH
Shoot This draws you a frame when you do not know how to shoot a place.
Rate My Shot gives an honest verdict on a frame you already took.
Ready to Roll gives you shutter, ISO, ND and white balance as numbers, not opinions.

CAMERA ASSISTANT
Exposure solver for video and photo, shutter angle, ND stops, flicker safe shutter speeds, slow motion and storage estimates. Check the sun position and the golden hour before you drive to a location.

ON SET

SHARE IT
Export the whole project as a PDF for your client, your camera operator or your own pocket. Invite your crew with a code and they work on the project with you, for free.

EVERYTHING SYNCS
Projects, boards and references sync across your devices and stay available offline.

FREE AND PREMIUM

name: Timelyshot
description:
On 12 August 2026 the Moon's shadow sweeps across Greenland, Iceland and then Spain, from Galicia and Asturias down to the Mediterranean coast and the Balearics: the first total solar eclipse visible from mainland Spain in over a century, and a deep partial one across the rest of Europe. TimelyShot tells you what you will see from the exact spot where you plan to be, and at what time.

THE ECLIPSE OF 12 AUGUST 2026

- Calculate from your exact spot. Tap the map where you actually plan to watch it, not the nearest big city.
- The path of totality drawn on the map, plus how far you are from it. If you are 20 km short, you know before leaving home.
- Local times for every phase: first contact, maximum and last contact.
- Real darkness: the drop in light your eye will actually perceive, not just the fraction of the Sun's disc that is covered. Human vision is logarithmic, so at 99 % of the disc covered there is still plenty of light. The app explains it and also gives you the technical figure.
- Altitude of the Sun above the horizon at maximum. That day the Sun is very low, so a hill or a building can hide the key moment from you.
- Augmented reality: point your camera at the sky and see the Sun's path drawn over the real landscape, exactly where it will be during the eclipse. If something blocks it, you find out now instead of on the day.
- Eclipse animation with a simulated clock and adjustable speed, so you know what to expect minute by minute.
- Countdown and calendar reminder.

And it is not a one-off: on 2 August 2027 totality returns, this time across southern Spain, North Africa and Egypt, and on 26 January 2028 there is an annular eclipse at sunset. The app handles every eclipse in its catalogue the same way, solar and lunar.

THE REST OF THE YEAR

TimelyShot is a planning tool for sun and moon photography.

- Sun and moon alignments: where and when the Sun or the Moon will sit above the landmark, the mountain or the window you choose.
- Sunrise, sunset and golden hour from the exact point you mark.
- Augmented reality to check on site whether your view is clear, without waiting for the day itself.
- Satellite and terrain maps so you can pick your spot properly.
- Cities and landmarks around the world with dates already worked out, for inspiration.
- My alignments: your saved calculations, with filters to find them fast.
- Compass with a calibration warning and a reliability indicator, so augmented reality points where it should.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Choose what you want to see (Sun, Moon or an eclipse) and where from, by tapping the map.
2. Pick a date, or let the app tell you when it happens.
3. The app works out the path, the times and the altitudes.
4. See the result on the map and in augmented reality.

WHO IT IS FOR

Landscape and architecture photographers, amateur astronomers, and anyone who wants to be in the right place at the right time on 12 August.

SAFETY

Never look at the Sun directly, or through your camera, without certified eclipse glasses (ISO 12312-2). Only during the seconds of totality is it safe to look with the naked eye.

An internet connection is needed to calculate. Results are saved in your history.

description:
Tired of fumbling with tempo between songs? Stage Metronome lets you save every song's settings in a setlist — ready at the right BPM in one tap for every song in your set.

Three configurable beat light patterns and per-device audio-visual delay calibration ensure the click and the light land at the same moment on your specific device.

STAY IN CONTROL ON STAGE

Tap the SYNC button to reset the beat to 1 without stopping or changing tempo — useful when the count gets lost mid-song. Connect a Bluetooth page turner or headset to start, stop, navigate songs, and adjust volume without putting down your instrument. The metronome keeps running in the background when you switch apps or the screen turns off.

DIAL IN YOUR CLICK

Choose from 6 click sounds. Set the volume independently for the accent beat, the main beat, and the sub-beat so the click mix works in any monitor environment — from a quiet rehearsal room to a loud stage. Use tap tempo to set BPM by feel, or hit the half/double buttons to switch between full-time and half-time in an instant. Tempo range covers 10 to 500 BPM with 12 beat-pattern presets.

FOR PRACTICE AND REHEARSAL

All the same settings work for band rehearsal and solo practice. The in-app timer tracks session length. Notification controls let you start, stop, and manage the click from the lock screen without opening the app.

WHO IT'S FOR

Stage Metronome is built for live musicians and bands who need a reliable click track on stage — drummers keeping the kit locked to a setlist, guitarists and bassists who need the right tempo loaded without touching the phone mid-performance, and anyone who has lost their tempo at a gig because their metronome was too fiddly under pressure. 40+ MUSIC SERVICES

ONE ACCOUNT, EVERY DEVICE

CLEAN UP YOUR LIBRARY

ACCURATE TRACK MATCHING

WHO IT IS FOR
Anyone leaving one service for another, testing several at once, or tired of being locked in. Built for anyone whose library has to travel with them, from curators to DJs.

WALKUP SONGS
Tap a player, their announcement plays, their song kicks in, and it fades out when they reach the plate. Set precise start points and durations with a simple editor. Done.

BETWEEN INNINGS
Dedicated inning break songs with automatic fade-out before play resumes. Set it and forget it. Grab a hot dog while the music runs itself.

SITUATIONAL & PREGAME
One-touch access to your national anthem, rally songs, team fight song, and anything else that fits the moment. Pre-game playlists keep the warmup energy going without interruption.

BUILT FOR REAL GAME DAY
After 12 years and thousands of games, the details matter:
- Announcement and song mixing with volume ducking
- Built-in equalizer for any speaker setup
- Tested with popular Bluetooth speakers
- Import your own music files, recordings, or professional announcer audio
- Automatic splitting of combined professional announcer files
- Support for multiple teams and as many players as you can create
- Works with Apple Music or imported audio files (MP3, M4A, WAV, CAF)

WHY WALKOUT SONG DJ?
- One-time purchase. No subscriptions, no monthly fees, no credits to run out
- Actively developed and supported since 2013
- Responsive one-on-one customer support from the developer, no chatbot or ticket queue
- Used by travel ball, rec league, high school, and college teams

name: Functional Ear Trainer
description:
Ear training can be easy and fun! With a right approach.

Have you (or one of your friends) ever wanted to learn to transcribe or play music by ear?

It is so important for a musician to know what you are hearing. A good musical ear helps when you are composing, improvising, transcribing melodies, or playing with others.

Most likely you have already tried different programs to learn to recognize intervals or even to acquire perfect pitch. However, although such programs develop your ear, but can you actually play any melody you hear as soon as you listen to it?

Imagine you could understand music… It is like when somebody is talking to you, you not only hear pleasant sounds, but you recognize words and their meaning.

One day I came across Alain Benbassat's program called “Functional Ear Trainer” and have been using it ever since. It is based on Alain's ear training method to learn to recognize tones.

The main difference between the Functional Ear Trainer and other methods is that it teaches you to distinguish between tones in the context of a particular musical key. You begin to recognize the role (or function) of each tone in this key, which is incredibly similar to its role in other keys of the same scale.

And it is *guaranteed* anyone can gradually develop this skill. It does not matter:
– who you are – an absolute beginner in music or a virtuoso professional musician;
– how old you are – a 3 yo kid or a 90+ adult;
– what musical instrument you play (you don't even have to play one).

The only requirement is to practice for 10 minutes a day.

I was so excited about this ear trainer that I have developed an Android app based on the Alain Benbassat method. I hope you will find it useful.

Download this app right now, and have fun with your ear training!

description:

WHAT’S NEXT

One more helpful cue for your baby’s day.

What’s Next uses on-device AI to turn recent activity logs into personalized timing cues. Depending on what you’ve logged, it may show:

• A likely wind-down window before sleep
• An estimated length for the next nap or sleep
• An approximate wake-up window
• An estimated time for the next feed
• A suggested time to check the diaper

Cues can start appearing after just a few logs. Regular, complete logging helps make them more personal to your baby’s developing routine.

What’s Next is optional. All core tracking features remain free.

GUIDANCE, NOT A SCHEDULE

Use What’s Next alongside your baby’s own cues and your judgment—not as a fixed schedule or instruction.

What’s Next is not medical advice. Contact a healthcare professional if you have concerns about your baby’s health, sleep or feeding.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

What’s Next cues are created directly on your device. Your baby’s logs aren’t sent to us to generate them.

BABY FEEDING & BREASTFEEDING TRACKER

• Use the breastfeeding timer to track nursing on each breast
• Quickly see which side you last used
• Keep a bottle feeding log for formula and expressed breast milk
• Record solid foods and notes about preferences or reactions
• Review feeding times and your baby’s changing routine

PUMPING & BREAST MILK TRACKER

• Record pumping sessions and milk amounts
• Keep a breast pump log alongside your feeding records

BABY SLEEP TRACKER & NAP LOG

• Record daytime naps and nighttime sleep
• Use the sleep timer to keep a baby sleep log
• Review sleep patterns as your baby’s sleep schedule changes
• Set reminders and alarms
• See personalized What’s Next sleep and wake-up cues

DIAPER TRACKER

• Log wet, dirty and mixed diapers
• Quickly see when the last diaper change occurred
• Keep a diaper log with a clear history of changes

BABY GROWTH TRACKER

• Track weight, height and head circumference
• Follow infant growth charts based on World Health Organization standards

HEALTH & DEVELOPMENT

• Record medications, vaccinations and temperature
• Keep baby health records and notes together
• Use the baby milestone tracker to save first smiles, words and steps
• Add photos and notes to your baby journal

CHARTS & REPORTS

• Review daily, weekly and monthly activity charts
• Recognize patterns across sleep, feeding and diaper records
• Share useful information with caregivers and healthcare professionals

SYNC & SHARING

• Sync baby records across multiple devices
• Keep parents, family members and other caregivers up to date
• Track the same baby together without maintaining separate logs

BABY TRACKER PLUS

Baby Tracker Plus is an optional auto-renewing subscription that includes ad-free tracking and personalized What’s Next sleep, feed and diaper cues.

Pricing, billing periods and renewal terms are shown in the app before you subscribe. You can manage or cancel your subscription through Google Play.

This App is a handy and reliable assistant for breastfeeding your newborn baby. You can track breastfeeding, bottle feeding, solid feedings and milk pumping.
