With this breastfeeding tracker you can:

✔️ Track feeding by one breast or by both, if you give your baby two breasts at one feeding
✔️ Track bottle feeding
✔️ Measure solid food feeding - food type and amount
✔️ If you need to pump your milk, measure how many ml/oz of each breast were expressed with a pump log
✔️ Tracking diaper changes, you can note whether it is wet or dirty, or both :)
✔️ You’ll always know how many diapers were changed per day
✔️ Record baths, temperatures, walks, and medications
✔️ Handy breastfeeding timer and sleep timer are easy to stop and to restart
✔️ Your baby's height and weight can be measured almost daily! They are also easily stored in the baby diary.
✔️ You can add a reminder for each event - periodic and easy-to-set
✔️ Displays baby nursing and sleeping timers in the notification bar, so you have easy access to the App
✔️ Logging and tracking activity of multiple babies. Supports twins!

Being a FTM (first-time mom), or new mom, in general, is very tiring and challenging! You got through pregnancy, you’ve probably just made it home from the hospital, are totally exhausted, and a little overwhelmed by your new responsibilities. The first few months of your baby’s life mostly revolves around a schedule of eating, sleeping, diaper changes and occasional little doctor’s visits.

It’s not always easy to remember the last time you fed your baby or changed their nappy. It’s very helpful to monitor everything and get a quick glance to remind you the last time you did it, or the next time you have to. It will definitely give you a peace of mind and make your day that much easier to have a log to check whenever needed.

It’s extremely important to track when you had your last feeding session, but also track the weight and how long they were eating to make sure they’re eating properly and gaining weight at a normal rate.

Also, keeping track of diapers is very imperative to keeping your baby healthy. All moms definitely need an easy way to check how often they’re changing diapers. Not to mention, you should definitely track if everything looks normal during diaper changes.

For some parents, it’s very important to track every ounce of food and it’s imperative they have a baby feeding tracker. Some babies, unfortunately, have minor illnesses after coming home from the hospital. Keeping track of all this information will help your baby on the road to recovery and healthy growth much more easily.

As a new mom, don’t forget to take care of yourself as well. The first few weeks will be tiring! There will definitely be times you fall asleep on the couch suddenly, and everyone needs some help or handy reminders. Alarms and graphs are a great way to have an at-a-glance look at what you need to do without stressing over “what if I forget?”.

Just click the appropriate button to begin feeding, or other activities. Your baby care history will be reliably stored. All this information may be useful when you visit the pediatrician, as well as for the further development of your child.

Feed baby easily and quickly. This breastfeeding app helps you track everything and enjoy motherhood.

MilkBar is a pumping tracker and breast milk storage app in one. Track every bag of breast milk in your fridge, freezer and deep freezer, time your pumping sessions with the pump timer, share your milk stash with your partner, and know exactly when you can stop pumping.

Made for exclusive pumping moms, moms who pump and breastfeed, and working moms building a freezer stash before going back to work. No spreadsheets, no sticky notes, no guessing.

BREAST MILK STASH, BAG BY BAG
• Track breast milk storage in your fridge, freezer and deep freezer
• Log each milk storage bag on its own, or group bags into bricks
• See how much milk you have in each spot at a glance
• Get expiration reminders and use the oldest milk first, so no liquid gold goes to waste

PUMP TIMER AND PUMPING LOG
• Time every pumping session with the built-in pump timer
• Log left and right sides separately
• Keep a clear pumping log of when you pumped and how much
• Use the pumping calculator to plan your daily milk supply goal
• Set pumping reminders so you never miss a session

STATS THAT MAKE SENSE
• See how much breast milk is stored, used and still left in every location
• Daily, weekly, monthly and yearly charts for your stash and milk supply

STOP PUMPING COUNTDOWN
• See the date your current freezer stash will last until
• Daily storage and stash goals calculated for you
• Know how much more milk you need before you can stop pumping or start weaning

SHARE WITH YOUR PARTNER OR CAREGIVER
• Share your milk stash with dad, grandma, your nanny or daycare
• Everyone knows how much breast milk is left, no more "how much is in the freezer?" texts
• Create a stash card that sums up your whole milk supply in one view

Switch between oz and mL anytime. Your data is safely backed up in the cloud.

MilkBar is built by a solo developer who reads every email and improves the app based on feedback from real pumping moms. Questions or ideas? muammerdev3@gmail.com

Log breastfeeding and bottle feeds with timestamps so you always know when the last feed happened.

Track every stored bag and bottle with first-in-first-out guidance so the oldest milk gets used first. Never lose track of your freezer supply again.

Quick reference for how long expressed milk keeps at room temperature, in the fridge, and in the freezer.

⏱️ Power Pumping Timer
A built-in guided timer for power pumping sessions to help boost supply.

🧾 Reimbursement Receipts
Save pump-related receipts in one place and export PDF reports for FSA, HSA, or insurance reimbursement.

Keep notes from your consultant or pediatrician handy between appointments.

Track water and food intake to spot what works for you.

🔔 Pumping Reminders
Set reminders so you never miss a session during the day or overnight.

Tools to help you plan your pumping schedule around your work day.

FREE & PRO

Log every session: time, duration, left/right or total volume, notes and tags.
See your day at a glance: number of sessions, total volume, time since your last pump and average pace.

Start without an account: your data stays on your device.


PREMIUM FEATURES — SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED


Full history and detailed stats: volumes over time, trends, left/right breakdown, equipment, flange sizes and power pumping.
Milk stash management: bags in the fridge or freezer, remaining volume, use-by dates, and what to use up soon.
Equipment tracking: pumps, flange sizes and the notes worth keeping.
Guided power pumping: preparation countdown, phase transitions, pauses and custom protocols.
Optional cloud backup: export, restore and use across several devices, with explicit consent.
Collaborative sharing: share a profile with a co-parent or someone you trust, with the permissions you choose.


MADE FOR TIRED DAYS
PumpDiary keeps things readable, quick to tap and kind in tone. The goal is to take weight off your mental load, not to add one more complicated app to your day.

LOCAL FIRST, CLOUD BY CHOICE
You can start without an account: your data stays on your device. An email account is only used to link Premium or restore a purchase. Cloud sync stays optional and requires your explicit consent, including for health-related data.

PREMIUM — OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION
PumpDiary Premium is an optional auto-renewing subscription, purchased through Google Play. The price and billing period are shown in the app before you confirm. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel in your Google Play account before the end of the current period.

PRIVACY

Privacy policy: https://www.pumpdiary.com/en#privacy

IMPORTANT — HEALTH INFORMATION
PumpDiary is a personal logging and planning tool for people who express breast milk.
PumpDiary is not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition, and it is not a substitute for medical advice.
For any question about your health, your baby's health or your breastfeeding journey, please speak with a qualified healthcare professional: a doctor, midwife, lactation consultant or pediatrician.

name: Workout Log & Tracker: PUMP UP
description:
To all serious lifters.

Have you ever noticed how "weird" modern workout apps have become?

■ The "Checkpost" before you even lift
You just want to log today’s weights, but first—create an account.
Is that really necessary?
Why do you need to surrender your email just to record a set of squats?
Will that email add even 1lb to your squat? We don’t think so.

■ Unsolicited advice from "Mr. AI"
"AI-generated workout plans!"

Does it really know how well you slept last night or how your joints feel today?

The only person who truly understands your limits is you—not a black-box algorithm.

Are you really okay with sending your training data to a remote server for "generic analysis"?

■ Your data, held hostage
Cloud-only apps mean your progress disappears if the service shuts down.

And even some "offline" apps, if you read the privacy policy carefully, may still use your data for analytics or marketing.

■ The "Graveyard" of pre-set exercises
Hundreds of exercises are pre-installed, making it harder to find what you actually use.

And when you finally add a custom move, you realize it already existed under a slightly different name. Frustrating, right?

■ Excessive "Animations"
If you need a 3D animation just to understand a movement mid-set… it might be overdesigned.

Focus on your form, not your screen.

■ The "Paywall" Ambush
"Want to add more exercises? Pay up!"
"Want to see your history? Subscribe now!"

Since when did anyone else get the right to put a limit on your hard work?

PUMP UP was built to strip away these "standard assumptions."

・No Registration: Start logging 3 seconds after installation.
・100% Offline: Data stays on your device. No tracking.
・CSV Freedom: Your data is your asset. Export and import anytime.
・Zero Limits: No caps on exercises or history.
・Zero Noise: Focus entirely on your gains.

If you’ve ever felt "this isn't right" with other apps, give PUMP UP a try.

"Yeah, this is exactly what I wanted."

It’s not flashy. No bells and whistles.
Just a tool for those who want to grind in silence and track their evolution.

Key Features of PUMP UP

■ Offline Independence
Everything is stored locally. No servers, no data leaks, no dependency.
Log your sets anywhere—even off-grid.
(Note: A small banner ad is displayed only when online to support development, but it never accesses your workout data.)


■ "Build Your Own" Efficiency
We don't bloat the app with 500 exercises you'll never use.

・No noise.
・No searching.
・No duplicates.

"Build your own routine." Simple and fast.

■ Speed-First UI
Stop tapping "Add Set" over and over.

PUMP UP uses a horizontal-entry UI designed for speed.

Instantly reference or copy your last 5 sessions—or just a single set.

■ Data is Your Asset
Full CSV export/import support.

We don’t lock you in. Use your data freely in spreadsheets, custom tools, or your own analysis workflows.

■ Everything Else a Lifter Needs

・Calendar: Visualize consistency
・Customization: Fully flexible structure
・Workout Planning: Remove daily hesitation
・RPE & Tags: Capture intensity and context
・Body Tracking: Weight, measurements, progress photos
・Cardio Support: Running, cycling, rowing

Finally

No flashy features. No distractions.
Just a fast UI and your data in a clean CSV.

"This is all I need."

We’re looking for lifters who enjoy the grind, value privacy, and want full ownership of their progress.

Keep your gains. Keep your data. Keep grinding.

name: CDC Milestone Tracker
developer: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
description:
Milestones matter! Track your child’s milestones from age 2 months to 5 years with CDC’s easy-to-use checklists; get tips from CDC to support your child’s development; and find out what to do if you ever have concerns about your child's development.

From birth to age 5, your child should reach milestones in how he or she plays, learns, speaks, acts and moves. Photos and videos in this app illustrate each milestone and make tracking them for your child easy and fun! Spanish photos and videos are coming soon!

Features:
• Add a Child – enter personalized information about your child or multiple children
• Milestone Tracker – track your child’s development by looking for important milestones using an interactive checklist
• Milestone Photos and Videos – know what each milestone looks like so that you can better identify them in your own child.
• Tips and Activities – support your child’s development at every age
• When to Act Early – know when it’s time to “act early” and talk with your child’s doctor about developmental concerns
• Appointments – keep track of your child’s doctors’ appointments and get reminders about recommended developmental screenings
• Milestone Summary – get a summary of your child’s milestones to view, and share with or email to your child’s doctor and other important care providers

For more information and free tools to help you track your child’s milestones, visit www.cdc.gov/ActEarly.

*This milestone checklist is not a substitute for a standardized, validated developmental screening tool. These developmental milestones show what most children (75% or more) can do by each age. Subject matter experts selected these milestones based on available data and expert consensus.

CDC does not collect or share any personal information that can be used to identify you or your child.

Hello! My name is Dima, father of Elli and founder of Sprouty. When she was born I needed to understand her growth spurts and developmental leaps but couldn't find the right app, so I built one. Today, millions of moms and dads monitor their baby's growth and development with Sprouty every day. Thank you for being part of this journey.

This senior citizen app allows a senior to be socially engaged, contribute to family or community, continue with activities that give life meaning, and to maintain choice and control. Automatic sensor notifications help a person to feel connected and involved with their family.

[4] Senior care app
A remote family member can receive an automatic notification telling them what time their loved one woke up (which is nice and reassuring), and more notifications throughout the day: what time they took their medicine; if they went outside for a walk, and what time a caregiver went to visit them, etc.. The app has special large icons that make it easier for a person to express the care needs and feelings.

[5] Dementia and Alzheimer’s app
If a loved one suffers from a decline in memory or confusion, perhaps Alzheimer’s disease, dementia or Parkinson’s disease, then this senior app can support daily living. You can setup tasks remotely, add notes and add photos, it will then pop-up as a notification on your loved ones phone. Great for independent living.

[6] Elderly phone app
This elderly phone app has background sensors that run 24/7 and lets family and caregivers see how much the phone/tablet device is being used and whether the battery is being kept charged,…

[7] Elderly launcher app
This elderly launcher app has large buttons for making phone calls, opening favorite websites, and clicking favorite places for Sat-Nav. So no fiddly keyboard typing. A great feature of this senior launcher app is that it can be setup remotely by family and caregivers.

[8] Caregivers app
This caregivers app helps organize care visits and enables remote caregivers to monitor and support the health & well-being of seniors with a wide range of care needs and frailty: motion sensors can monitor people with mobility and fall safety concerns; automatic care-plan popup reminders help people maintain their health and independence,…

PRIVACY
This senior citizen app works by consent - each person can chose what features to switch on and share.

SUMMARY - This senior app is designed to promote senior safety, senior health, and senior living. The app features built-in phone sensors, external home IoT sensors (due October 2021), GPS tracking and automatic geo-fence location alerts, and advanced daily recurring tasks and reminders to protect and monitor the health of an elderly person. It’s great for someone who is active and independent, and also for those with health issues, such as frailty, Alzheimer’s or Dementia, and need additional support and care. And its a senior launcher app with large buttons for phone calls and websites.

name: Caregiver: Elderly Care Log
description:
Caring for aging parents is rarely a one-person job. Reminders, doctor visits and "did anyone pick up the prescription?" messages pile up in a group chat until something slips. Caregiver Planner gives a family caregiver one calm place to organize elder care: medication reminders, tasks, appointments, a care log and the numbers you call most.

It is an organizer for the logistics of caregiving, not a medical app. It helps you plan, remind, hand over and keep track. It never gives dosing, diagnosis or treatment advice.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Profile: add the person you look after, whether a parent, a spouse or someone else, with a relationship and notes.
• Medication reminders: add each medication as printed on the label and the times you want a reminder. Log each one as taken or skipped, or snooze it for 15 minutes. The app reminds you of the time only and never suggests what or how much to take.
• Tasks: add jobs like "pick up prescription" or "call the clinic", note who is doing it, set a due date and check it off.
• Appointments: keep doctor and specialist visits with the provider, place and notes, and get a reminder before each one. After a visit, write down what was decided and turn follow-ups into tasks.
• Log: note visits, calls and updates. Group entries into concern threads ("sleep at night", "swollen ankle") so you can tell a clinician how long something has been going on.
• Contacts: save doctor, pharmacy, nurse and family numbers, and pin two to Today for a one-tap call.
• Rotation: set a weekly pattern of who is on duty and when, with an end-of-shift reminder.
• Handoff brief: reminder times, the next tasks and appointments, recent updates and who to call, ready to send to a sibling or save as a PDF.
• A weekly recap you can share, and a log export as a PDF for your own records.
• Prep checklists: pick a situation (specialist visit, hospital discharge, home safety, organizing medications, new diagnosis questions, in-home help, documents) and get an organizational checklist of questions to ask, papers to bring and jobs to divide up.

FREE TO START, NO SIGN-UP

Start as a guest right away; your plan stays on your phone. The free version covers one person:
• up to 5 active medication reminders
• unlimited tasks, appointments, log entries and contacts
• handoff brief, weekly recap and PDF export
• one AI checklist to try

The free version shows ads: banners for our other apps and an occasional full-screen ad after you save a task or an appointment.

PRO, FOR FAMILIES WHO SHARE THE LOAD

• Care Circle: invite siblings and other helpers with a code and post tasks, log notes and duty shifts to a shared feed everyone in the circle sees. It updates when the app opens or when you refresh.
• More than one person, each with their own Today, tasks and schedule.
• Unlimited medication reminders.
• Unlimited AI prep checklists, plus AI visit preparation and follow-up suggestions (up to 30 a month).
• Cloud backup and restore (with a free account).
• No ads.

Pro is a monthly or annual subscription. The free senior care organizer stays useful on its own.

YOUR DATA

As a guest, your plan is stored on your phone. Care Circle and cloud backup store the shared or backed-up items on our servers. AI checklists and suggestions are drafted by a third-party AI service (OpenRouter), only after you agree; medication names and recent log entries are sent only if you switch that option on. We use Firebase for sign-in, analytics and crash reports, and Google AdMob for ads in the free version.

NOT MEDICAL ADVICE

Caregiver Planner helps you coordinate the day-to-day of looking after an elderly parent or loved one. It does not provide medical, dosing or health advice. For any medical question, consult a licensed professional; in an emergency, call your local emergency number.

name: Elder Care: Pill Reminder Log
description:
Elder Care is a free medicine reminder and personal health record built for older adults and the family members who look after them. Big text, plain words, one-tap answers — and everything stays on your own phone.

NEVER MISS A DOSE
• Reminders at the exact time you set — not "sometime in the next 15 minutes"
• Answer from the notification: "I took it" or "Remind me later"
• Every schedule real prescriptions use: daily, set weekdays, every few days, monthly, every N hours, cycles like 21 days on / 7 off, and as-needed
• Steroid tapers and short courses: the dose steps down on its own and reminders stop on the last day
• "With food / before food / empty stomach" printed on the reminder itself
• Double-dose check: if you already took it minutes ago, the app asks before recording another
• Skip with a reason ("felt unwell", "ran out", "doctor said stop") — the reason goes into your doctor report
• Refill warnings in days, not just tablets — and a warning if a course cannot be finished with what is left
• Reminder health check: send yourself a test alert, and get step-by-step battery fixes for Xiaomi, Samsung, Huawei, OPPO, vivo, OnePlus, realme, TECNO and more

SCAN A LABEL INSTEAD OF TYPING
Point the camera at the box. Name, strength, form and directions are read on the phone — nothing is uploaded — and you check them before saving.

TRACK HOW YOU ARE DOING
• Blood pressure, blood sugar, pulse, oxygen, temperature, weight, breathing, sleep, water, steps
• Pain and mood on a faces scale — no arithmetic while you are hurting
• mg/dL or mmol/L, kg or lb, °C or °F — your choice
• Trend charts with the commonly published range shown for context
• Symptom diary with the medicine you suspect — the app counts and dates them for your appointment, and never claims a cause

KEEP YOUR PAPERS
Photograph prescriptions, lab reports, X-rays, hospital letters and vaccination cards. Search them by the words on the page. Lab values are read off a scanned report and offered for you to confirm — with the range your own laboratory printed.

LAB RESULTS
130 common tests — HbA1c, creatinine, cholesterol, TSH, vitamin D and more — with history and charts per test.

READY FOR THE DOCTOR
• Doctor report PDF: what was taken, what was missed and why, readings, symptoms
• Readings export as PDF or CSV, choose the dates per metric
• Visit preparation: what to mention and what to ask, assembled from your own record
• Family update: a short plain-text message for whoever helps you
• Wallet-sized emergency card with allergies, conditions, medicines and contacts

MADE FOR OLDER EYES AND HANDS
Four text sizes, stronger-contrast mode, dark mode, full-width buttons, no long-press secrets, spelled-out "Required" instead of a tiny asterisk, and every date written out in words.

TWO PEOPLE, ONE PHONE
Keep separate records for yourself and the person you care for, and switch with one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No server. No analytics. No ads. No subscription. Your record is encrypted on this phone and the key stays in your phone's own secure keystore. Sharing a report, a card or a backup is a file you hand over yourself. Uninstalling removes everything.

Elder Care records what you tell it and shows it back to you. It does not diagnose, dose or replace your doctor or pharmacist.

Free forever. Made with care for the people who need it most.

name: Stool Tracker: Bowel Diary
description:

Built for adults managing irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis (UC), microscopic colitis, IBD flares, celiac disease, SIBO, chronic constipation, chronic diarrhea, food intolerances, and post-surgical bowel recovery.

📋 LOG YOUR STOOL
Capture each bowel movement with clinical precision:
- Bristol Stool Scale types 1 through 7
- Color, volume, odor, and consistency
- Presence of blood, mucus, or undigested food
- Floating versus sinking
- Urgency and straining level
- Pain during or after evacuation
- Time of day and duration on the toilet
- Built-in poop timer for accurate tracking
- Flatulence and bloating severity
- Free-text notes for anything unusual

🍽 FOOD AND FODMAP DIARY
Connect what you eat to how your gut responds:
- Meal logging with food categories and portions
- Low-FODMAP and elimination diet tracking
- Gluten-free, lactose-free, fructose-free, and histamine-free diet logs
- Dairy, wheat, soy, egg, and nightshade intolerance monitoring
- Fiber, water, and probiotic intake
- Caffeine and alcohol consumption
- Trigger food identification over time
- Meal-to-stool transit time estimates

💊 MEDICATIONS AND SUPPLEMENTS
Track your full GI regimen and monitor response:
- Antidiarrheals like Imodium (loperamide)
- Laxatives including MiraLAX, Dulcolax, and senna
- Fiber supplements like Metamucil and Benefiber
- Antispasmodics like dicyclomine and hyoscine
- PPIs and H2 blockers for acid reflux
- Biologics like Humira, Entyvio, Stelara, and Remicade for IBD
- Immunomodulators like azathioprine and methotrexate
- 5-ASA drugs like mesalamine and sulfasalazine
- Probiotics, digestive enzymes, and L-glutamine
- Dose changes, refill reminders, and side effect notes

⚠️ TRIGGERS AND FACTORS
The context behind every gut episode:
- Stress level and sleep quality
- Menstrual cycle phase and hormonal shifts
- Exercise and physical activity
- Travel and time zone changes
- Antibiotic use and post-antibiotic recovery
- Illness, fever, and infection
- Custom triggers you discover over time

📈 INSIGHTS AND REPORTS
Weeks of entries become a clear clinical picture:
- Stool frequency and consistency trends
- Bristol Scale distribution charts
- Food-to-symptom correlation analysis
- Medication response timelines
- Constipation and diarrhea pattern detection
- Flare frequency and duration tracking
- Monthly PDF and CSV exports for your doctor
- Over 30 chart types across all tracked factors

🩺 SHARE WITH YOUR DOCTOR
- One-tap reports for gastroenterology visits
- Highlight flare episodes and ER events
- Colonoscopy and endoscopy prep tracking
- Share read-only access with caregivers or partners

📚 GUT HEALTH EDUCATION
- Bristol Stool Scale reference and interpretation
- FODMAP food lists and reintroduction guides
- IBS, IBD, and celiac disease overviews
- Constipation and diarrhea management tips
- Gut-brain axis and stress-digestion connection

🛡️ PRIVACY AND SECURITY
- Optional passcode and biometric lock
- Offline-first, your data stays on your device
- Encrypted cloud backup you control
- No ads, no selling your data, ever

Your gut health is data. Stool Tracker gives you the record and patterns to advocate for better care, adjust treatment with your doctor, and finally understand what your body is telling you.

Disclaimer: Stool Tracker is for informational and personal tracking use only. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical concerns.

name: Dog Walker & Pet Sitter Log
description:
PawVisit is the record book for a solo dog walker or pet sitter. The client and pet cards, the visit log with a timer, the card you send the owner after a walk, and the weekly invoice. It works offline and your records stay on your phone.

WHAT IT DOES

The visit
Tap the pet, tap start, walk the dog, tap stop. Add a photo and tap what happened as you go: walked, fed, water, peed, pooped, meds given, playtime, let out, litter. The timer is worked out from the moment you started, so locking the phone or taking a call does not lose it.

The visit card
When you stop, PawVisit builds a card: the photo, the pet's name, the date, the start time, how long you were out, what happened and your note. You share it from your own phone through WhatsApp, a text or email, whichever the owner prefers. There is no client app for them to install and nothing is sent automatically.

Clients and pets
Name, phone, address, how to get in, the alarm code, the key tag, the emergency contact and the vet. For each pet: photo, breed, date of birth, weight, medication as the owner gave it, feeding notes, walking notes, and the things you need before you open the door, like pulls on the lead, reactive, never off lead.

One visit can cover several pets from the same household and produces one card for them.

The key ring
Every key you hold and whose it is, sorted by the tag written on the fob. If a key goes missing you can see whose it is in seconds.

Invoices
Bill a client for a week or a month from the visits you completed, at their rate or your standard one. PDF with your own logo. Mark an invoice paid and how it was paid, and see what is owed at 14, 30 and over 30 days. PawVisit does not take payments.

Reminders
Tomorrow's visits, and an invoice still unpaid after two weeks.

Reports
Visits, hours worked and what your completed visits came to, by client, over four weeks to a year. That figure is the value of the work you finished, whether or not it has been invoiced or paid yet. Export to CSV.

Backup
One file with everything in it, photos included. It opens on another Android phone running PawVisit, and restoring adds what is missing rather than replacing what is there.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO

PawVisit asks for no location permission at all. It cannot record your route, it cannot see where you go, and there is no map. That is a property of the app, not a setting you have to trust.

There is no account and no sign-up. Your clients' alarm codes and key tags sit on your phone behind an optional app lock that uses your fingerprint, face or device PIN where your phone supports it.

The standard tier shows ads and the app reports crashes so faults can be fixed, so it is not an app that sends nothing at all. What it never sends is anything about where you have been, because it never knows.

WHO IT IS FOR

The one-person dog walker or pet sitter with ten to sixty regular clients who wants the record and the owner update from something built for one person rather than for a team.

The standard tier keeps ten pets, the visit log, the timer and the visit card. Everything you have already recorded stays readable, whatever tier you are on.

CONTACT

https://clearstackapps.com/privacy
https://clearstackapps.com/terms

name: PetVitality Pet Health Tracker
description:
PetVitality is a pet health tracker for dogs and cats, designed by veterinarians and built around what actually gets asked in the exam room: when was the last seizure, how much has the weight changed since spring, which vaccine is due. Nobody can hold all of that in their head. A good pet health tracker holds it for you, and it does the calculating.

Dog and cat health records in one place:

Each pet gets a profile with weight, active medications and the next treatment due on the front page.

What the health tracker follows

* Seizure tracker: log each seizure in under a minute with a timer and video. PetVitality calculates the seizure-free streak, a regularity score and an estimated window for the next seizure. For owners of epileptic dogs, this is the feature that changes how they plan their lives.
* Heat cycle tracker: average cycle, regularity and a forecast for the next heat with a date window you can add to your calendar.
* Weight tracker: quick weigh-ins in kg or lb, food changes marked on the chart so you can see whether the new diet worked, and an evaluation of the trend against your pet's breed and age. Works as a puppy growth chart too.
* Stool tracker and vomiting log: a 1 to 7 stool scale with photos, vomiting frequency with a warning when it clusters.
* Allergy tracker: symptom severity over time, so seasonal patterns become visible instead of remembered.
* Heart rate and breathing rate counter: tap along with each breath or beat, checked against normal ranges for dogs and cats.
* Mood, energy, diary entries, photos and documents, per pet.

Every tracker exports as a PDF. Bring it to the consultation or send it ahead. From the clinic side of the table, a clean seizure log or weight chart changes the quality of the decisions that get made, and that is the standard these reports are built to.

Medication reminder and vaccine tracker

* Vaccines, flea and tick treatments, dewormers and dental care, with the next due date on the front page and a reminder before it lapses.
* Medication reminder with dose schedules and plain-language information about each medicine.
* Routines: walks, feeding, tooth brushing, nail trims and vet visits, as repeating reminders.

For when things go wrong

* Chocolate toxicity calculator using your dog's actual weight and the type of chocolate, with clear guidance for each risk level and a button to call your vet.
* Emergency guides and articles written by veterinarians.

Pet sitter instructions:

Health status, emergency contacts, feeding, medication, exercise, behaviour and house rules, exported as one PDF with your pet's photo on it. This is free for everyone, because a well-informed sitter is better for every pet.

Most veterinary decisions depend on the information the owner brings to the appointment. PetVitality exists to make that information good.

Questions or suggestions: contact@petvitality.io

It includes veterinary calculators, reference material, drug dosages, and our medical math book (our medical math book is used as part of school curricula).

Perfect for veterinary technicians, veterinary nurses, veterinarians, and students.

Use Vetpocket™ as your all-in-one veterinary calculator, drug formulary, and clinical companion for quick answers to your questions and instant calculations, alloowing you to focus on your patients and leave work on time!

POWERFUL VETERINARY CALCULATORS
Perform accurate veterinary calculations in seconds with tools built for real clinical workflow:

Small Animals (Dogs and Cats):
• Veterinary drug dosage calculators
• Fluid therapy calculators for maintenance, dehydration, and ongoing losses
• Hypovolemic shock calculator
• CRI calculators
• Drip rate calculator
• Blood transfusion calculator
• Energy requirements calculator
• CPR and emergency calculators for critical cases when every second counts
• DKA calculators
• Unit conversion calculator
• Blood gas calculator
• C1V1 = C2V2 calculator
• Chocolate toxicity calculator
• Dextrose calculator
• General anesthesia fluid therapy calculator
• Magnesium calculator
• Phosphate calculator
• Magnesium calculator
• Potassium calculator (Scott's Sliding Scale and mEq/kg/hr)
• Regular insulin calculator
• Serum osmolarity calculator
• Sodium correction calculator
• Sodium correction for hyperglycemia calculator
• Total body water calculator

Exotic Animals (Zoo Med):
• Blood volume calculator
• Drug dilution calculator
• Hypovolemic shock calculator

CUSTOMIZABLE VETERINARY DRUG FORMULARY

Turn Vetpocket™ into your own veterinary drug nerd book:
• 140+ pre-filled veterinary drugs with built-in dosage calculators
• Edit default dosages to match your clinic or hospital protocols
• Add custom drugs, notes, and reminders to build your own veterinary drug reference

REFERENCE MATERIAL

Vetpocket™ is more than a vet calculator—it’s a quick clinical reference at the point of care:
• Endocrinology, cardiology, anesthesia, blood gas analysis, toxicology, and more
• Dentistry charts, eruption timelines, and parasitology with client-friendly handouts

MEDICAL MATH & EXAM SUPPORT

Reinforce vet math while you work:
• Built-in medical math book with 400+ practice problems and step-by-step solutions
• Great for VTNE, NAVLE, vet tech students, and vet students


HOSPITAL TEAMS & CONSISTENT CARE

Vetpocket™ is designed for the whole veterinary team:
• Veterinary technicians and vet nurses who calculate drug dosages, CRIs, and fluids all day
• Veterinarians in general practice, emergency, ICU, and specialty medicine
• Vet students and vet tech students who need a bridge from classroom to clinic

The Vetpocket™ School Program offers eligible veterinary and vet tech students a free year of Vetpocket™ Pro when they register with a verified school email, so they can bring a veterinary calculator and clinical reference from school into practice.


WHY VETPOCKET™?

• Quick, accurate, stress-free veterinary calculations
• Customizable veterinary drug reference and notes
• Emergency-ready calculators for CPR, shock doses, and reversals
• Helpful for VTNE, NAVLE, and ongoing medical math practice
• Used by veterinary professionals and students around the world

SOURCES & SUBSCRIPTION TERMS

Vetpocket™ content is based on trusted veterinary guidelines and manuals. A full list of sources is available in the app.

Vetpocket™ Pro is available as a monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription, which unlocks all Vetpocket™ calculators, content, and drug tools while active.

description:

Where available, our virtual veterinarians can also provide prescriptions for medication. Vetster is here to help from initial concern to diagnosis to prescription delivery.

Don’t wait! Get the care for your pet when you need it.

Vetster’s online veterinary doctors can help with:

- Itchy skin, excessive scratching, or fleas
- Irritated ears: shaking head, scratching, discharge, or odor
- Vomiting, diarrhea, or straining to poop
- Urinary problems: urinating more than normal, straining to urinate, or bloody urine.
- Eye problems
- Breathing issues: coughing, sneezing, or nasal congestion
- Limping, pain, or injury
- Ingestion of something potentially harmful.

Is your Dutch Terrier experiencing fatigue? Does your pet choke on their chewy toy?

Ask a vet your questions and receive peace of mind as well as pet health treatment. Whether you need an emergency vet, pet drugs or medicine from a pharmacy or veterinarian care for an animal species that's not common, the Vetster app can provide professional telehealth help right away.

When your vet clinic is closed, but you need answers—and quickly—Vetster has got you covered 24/7. Take out the stress and worry by getting the answers you need to take care of your pet from the comfort of your own home.

Using Vetster is simple and convenient:

- Download the Vetster App
- Create your free Vetster account
- Find a veterinarian based on your pet’s needs
- Choose your preferred time/date for an appointment
- Your Vetster Vet will confirm your appointment
- Change of plans? No worries! Reschedule for a credit or refund

What to expect during your appointment?

After booking your appointment, you’ll be connected to a licensed veterinarian or veterinary technician via video chat.

Similar to an in-person appointment, the licensed veterinarian or technician will ask you questions about your pet and their health history. They may also want to see your pet up-close to better examine them and gather more information about a tentative diagnosis.

The vet will let you know what the next steps are (such as booking an in-person appointment, sending you a prescription, how to treat at home, etc.)

That’s it!

Why choose Vetster?

Thousands of pet owners trust Vetster and our five-star rated virtual vets. Pets love it too because fewer trips to the vet mean less stress for them! Best of all, creating an account is 100% free!

description:

1. Photos/Media/Files – This allows the app to store the medical content and multimedia for offline use without requiring the user to reload all the large content when the app updates.
2. Device and App History – This is used only to keep the app and content up to date.

The Merck Veterinary Manual, a renowned animal health reference for more than 60 years, covers all species and disorders of veterinary interest worldwide.

This app provides veterinarians, students and other animal health professionals with clear, practical explanations of thousands of conditions across all body systems. It covers etiology, pathophysiology, and options for diagnosis and treatment.

The trusted Merck Veterinary app offers:

• Thousands of topics written and updated regularly by more than 400 veterinary experts from more than 20 countries
• Photos, illustrations, and video of thousands of disorders and diseases
• Quizzes* check knowledge of veterinary disorders, signs, and treatments
• Interactive Case Simulations* test ability to treat a specific patient over the disease course
• Clinical calculators
• Numerous reference guides and hundreds of useful tables
• Pet health content* written in consumer-friendly language for clients
• FAQ and User Guide

*Internet access needed.

About Merck Manuals
Our mission is simple:
We believe that health information is a universal right and that every person is entitled to accurate, accessible and usable medical information. We have a responsibility to protect, preserve and share the best current medical information to enable more informed decisions, enhance relationships between patients and professionals, and improve health care outcomes around the world.
That’s why we are making the Merck Manuals available for free in digital form to veterinary professionals and clients around the world. No registration or subscription required, and no ads.

description:
Notepet keeps your pet's health in one simple app: medications, vaccinations, and everyday wellbeing. From one pet owner to another, we built it to make your pet's care a little easier to manage, even on the busy days.

Free to start. Add your first pet in under a minute.

GETTING STARTED IS EASY
1. Add your pet's details
2. Set up medication schedules, vaccines, and health trackers
3. Get a reminder when something's due, then log it with one tap

💊 MEDICATIONS & REMINDERS
Never guess whether you've given a dose again. Schedule recurring medications, from three times a day to once a year, or keep on-demand meds as "as required." Mark each dose and see a clear history at a glance. Managing several medications? Organise them with custom labels and group your list to find what you need fast.

Stay ahead of refills, too. With stock tracking, Notepet counts your supply down with every dose, shows how much is left, and warns you when it's running low, so you can reorder or pick up a refill before you run out.

💉 VACCINATIONS
Record every vaccination with dates and who administered it. Notepet tracks expiry and reminds you before a renewal is due, so your pet stays protected and your records are always ready for the vet.

📈 HEALTH TRACKING
Log weight, temperature, mood, and activity, plus pet-specific scores like body condition, itch and stools. Watch trends over time with simple charts, so gradual changes don't go unnoticed.

📅 CALENDAR
See every dose, note, measurement, and vaccination in one place, in weekly or monthly view. Tap any day to add a record or review what's done.

👨‍👩‍👧 SHARE WITH FAMILY
Caring for a pet together? Create a group and invite family members or caregivers. Set Admin, Editor, or Viewer roles, and everyone stays in sync in real time, so no one double-doses and nothing gets forgotten.

🗒️ NOTES & CONTACTS
Jot down symptoms, activities, vet appointments, and conversations with the vet as notes. Keep your vet, clinic, and groomer contacts handy.

✨ AND MORE
• A clean, simple interface that stays out of your way on busy days
• Cloud backup and multi-device sync, so your records are safe and with you anywhere
• Dark theme that's easy on the eyes for late-night check-ins

BUILT FOR EVERY PET 🐶 🐱 🐰 🐦 🐹 🐢 🐠
Dogs, cats, rabbits, birds, hamsters, guinea pigs, chinchillas, ferrets, reptiles, fish, and more.

NOTEPET PLUS
Notepet is free to use. Upgrade to Notepet Plus anytime for unlimited pets, medications, and vaccines.

Download Notepet to never miss a dose and keep your pet's health on track.

name: Pet Medication & Pill Reminder
description:
A simple pet pill reminder and pet medication tracker for dog and cat owners. Add your dog or cat, add each medicine as your vet prescribed it with the time it is due, and get a reminder on your phone when it is time. Tap Log dose or Skip, and the Today view moves on to the next one — no sticky notes on the fridge, no guessing whether this morning's tablet already went in.

description:

(Settings > Import / Export)

Life Notes is an app that allows you to record your chronic symptoms and lifestyle habits on a daily basis in order to monitor them, but also to potentially highlight some correlations.

It's possible to create your own symptom list in order to score them day after day, rating thef pain level intensity on a scale from 0 to 5.

It's also possible to record your meals, medications and add various notes, as well as your sleep schedules to highlight the causes of your symptoms. For example, it is easier to highlight the link between some of your meals and your possible stomach aches.

In addition to noting the daily evolution of the symptoms at different times of the day, it's also possible to enter an overall level of pain intensity over the course of a day in order to have a broader view of their evolution.

In short, Life-Notes offers what a simple notebook could do for you, but with a focus on tracking symptoms and providing statistics.

None of your data is sent online, 100% of your data is stored on your phone's memory.

name: Upright – POTS Symptom Tracker
description:
Upright is a POTS tracker for people living with POTS (postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome), dysautonomia and the conditions that travel with them. Diagnosed or still chasing answers, Upright turns confusing daily symptoms into clear patterns you and your doctor can act on.

ONE POTS APP FOR YOUR WHOLE DAILY ROUTINE
POTS is managed every single day: salt loading, fluids, the standing heart rate test, medications and avoiding triggers. Upright brings your whole POTS routine into one simple dysautonomia tracker, with a Today screen that shows where you stand at a glance.

STANDING HEART RATE TEST (NASA LEAN TEST)
Record your resting heart rate lying down and your peak heart rate standing. Upright flags a rise of 30 bpm or more, the threshold used for POTS, and charts your standing heart rate over days and weeks. Add blood pressure readings to the same test: lying, then each standing measurement.

SALT, FLUID & ELECTROLYTE TRACKER
Log sodium and fluids in one tap and watch progress rings fill toward the daily targets your doctor set. For POTS, salt and electrolytes are frontline treatment, not a gimmick.

POTS SYMPTOM TRACKER & FLARE DIARY
Log dizziness, brain fog, racing heart, fatigue, nausea and fainting with a severity score and triggers like heat, standing, big meals and your menstrual cycle. Trends compares your symptom days with your low-salt days so you can see what sets off a POTS flare.

TRIGGER CORRELATIONS (PRO)
See each trigger ranked by how many episodes you tagged with it, its share of your flares and the average severity, over the last 30 days.

MEDICATION REMINDERS
Add midodrine, fludrocortisone, salt tablets, beta blockers or any other POTS medication with its dose and times. Upright reminds you when each dose is due, even when the app is closed, and tracks your adherence for the doctor report.

HISTORY
Browse every day you logged: salt, fluids, stand test and symptom episodes. The free plan keeps the last 30 days in view; Pro unlocks your full POTS history.

WEARABLE HEART RATE VIA HEALTH CONNECT (PRO)
With your permission, Upright reads the heart rate samples your watch recorded, through Health Connect and read-only, to fill in the resting and standing values of your stand test. Heart rate data is used only for the stand test and its trends, stays on your device and is never uploaded or shared.

DOCTOR-READY PDF & CSV REPORTS (PRO)
Export a POTS report with standing heart rate trends, symptom frequency, your top trigger, medication adherence and salt and fluid averages. Bring evidence to your cardiologist instead of a vague memory.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
No account. No cloud. Works offline. Your health data never leaves your device.

BUILT FOR THE DYSAUTONOMIA COMMUNITY
POTS, dysautonomia, MCAS, EDS and hypermobility, long COVID and every spoonie managing a chronic illness. Upright speaks English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Polish and Portuguese.

UPRIGHT PRO
PDF and CSV doctor reports, wearable heart rate sync, full trigger correlations and unlimited history. Start with a 7-day free trial on the annual plan; monthly and lifetime plans are available too. Invite a friend and you both get 30 days of Pro free.

MEDICAL DISCLAIMER
Upright is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. Stand test results and trends are for tracking only, not a diagnosis. WHY DID WE MAKE THIS?

TRACK IT BETTER. TREAT IT BETTER.
Pain is a complex experience. It often includes multiple pain types (layers), each with its own unique texture, intensity, location, and surface area.

By keeping a diary that integrates complex information, you can show your doctors what you are experiencing to help them make a better diagnosis, choose more appropriate medications and treatments, and monitor if your treatments are beneficial. PAIN IS DIFFERENT.

name: TrackerControl Slim
description:
TrackerControl Slim is an Android app that allows users to STUDY the widespread, ongoing, hidden data collection in mobile apps about user behaviour (‘tracking’).

To detect tracking, TrackerControl combines the power of the Disconnect tracker list, used by Firefox, and our in-house tracker list, created from analysing ~2 000 000 apps!

Additionally, TrackerControl detects tracker libraries in apps using the signatures from ClassyShark3xodus/Exodus Privacy for the analysis of tracker libraries within app code.

The app also aims to educate about your rights under Data Protection Law, such the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Under the hood, TrackerControl uses Android’s VPN functionality, to analyse apps’ network communications locally on the Android device. This is accomplished through a local VPN server, to enable network traffic analysis by TrackerControl. To establish this VPN, TrackerControl expands on the work from NetGuard.

No root is required, other VPNs or Private DNS are not supported. No external VPN server is used, to keep your data safe!

See the key points, recommendations, and next steps from the conversation without having to read through a long transcript.

Share with your care circle

Invite family members or caregivers to review summaries and stay aligned on what happened and what comes next.

BUILT FOR REAL CARE MOMENTS

Keep a useful history of appointments and summaries across doctors and specialists.

Older adults and caregivers

Help a parent, spouse, or loved one remember instructions, organize follow-up, and share updates.

Capture your child's appointments, questions, instructions, and follow-up care so important details are easier to remember.

WHAT IS BLUE LIGHT?
Blue light is the visible light spectrum (380-550nm) for circadian regulation. It contains more energy than other visible light types, so it may damage your retinal cells.

WHY SHOULD I USE BLUE LIGHT FILTER?
Research shows that exposure to blue light imposes serious threats to retinal neurons, causes eye strain, dry eyes, and inhibits the secretion of melatonin, a hormone that influences circadian rhythms. With our night shift function, your vision health will be greatly improved.

CAN BLUE LIGHT FILTER IMPROVE MY SLEEP?
Yes. Natural exposure to blue light during the daylight hours boosts people's energy, alertness and mood; however, it will disturb your sleep at night.(from wiki) Blue light filter can effectively reduce blue light from the screen and help you get better sleep.

RELEVANT SCIENTIFIC STUDIES 
1. Steven W. Lockley, George C. Brainard, Charles A. Czeisler. “High Sensitivity of the Human Circadian Melatonin Rhythm to Resetting by Short Wavelength Light”. J Clin Endocrinol Metab. 2003 Sep;88(9):4502-5.

The Schengen Area allows non-EU citizens to stay up to 90 days within any rolling 180-day period. This Schengen calculator tracks exactly how many days you've used and how many remain—no manual counting required.

MULTIPLE ENTRY VISA HOLDERS
Have a 1-year, 2-year, or 5-year multiple entry Schengen visa? You must still follow the 90/180 rule during each rolling period. This visa tracker monitors your compliance across your entire visa validity, preventing accidental overstays between entries.

• Color-coded status: green (safe), orange (caution), red (critical)

name: Plant Care Tracker - Ploi
description:
Ploi is a plant care tracker and plant diary for your houseplants. Log each watering and Ploi learns how often every plant really gets thirsty, then reminds you on a watering schedule that fits your home instead of a generic chart.

Watering reminders that learn

No app can know exactly how often to water a plant: light, humidity, pot size and the season all change the answer. So Ploi works it out from what you do. It looks at the last few waterings you logged, ignores the one-off gaps, and sets the next date from your real rhythm. Prefer a fixed interval for a particular plant? Switch that plant to fixed. Reminders arrive once a day, at the time you choose, as one list of everything that is due.

Reminders for the rest of your plant care

The same schedule works for fertilizing, misting, wiping leaves, repotting and pruning, and you can add care types of your own. Set a task every few days, or tie it to your waterings, such as fertilizer with every other watering.

Your plants on the home screen

Add the Ploi widget to your home screen and see what needs care without opening the app. Small sizes show what is next; the large one is a board of what is overdue, due today and due this week, with the weather where your plants live if you want it. Tap a plant and it opens. You choose what the widget shows and can write your own message for the days when everything is done.

A care log for every plant

Every watering, feeding, repotting and note goes into that plant's own timeline. One entry can hold several kinds of care, a note and photos, and you can edit it later. Long after, you can see exactly when you last fertilized, how long the plant went between waterings, or the day a new leaf opened. Watered a whole shelf? Select the plants and mark them all at once.

Growth photos and charts

Add photos to a plant or to any log entry and watch its story come together. A monstera, a snake plant or a peace lily looks different six months later, and Ploi keeps every photo. A growth chart tracks height, and a watering chart shows the gaps between waterings so you can spot the odd one out.

Rooms, weather and rain

Group plants by room, shelf or balcony, and mark each spot as indoor or outdoor. Ploi shows the weather where your plants are, and when you log rain, the next watering for outdoor plants moves back to match.

Share the care

Invite a partner, a roommate or a plant sitter. A caretaker can log waterings, notes and photos while you are away, and the history stays with the plant.

Plant care guides and identification

Look up a species in Ploi's care guides for its watering, light, toxicity and pest notes. Not sure what you have? Take a photo, identify the plant and start its care log right away.

Plant wishlist

Keep a wishlist of the plants you want next, so the ones you like are in one place for your next trip to the nursery.

Your records stay yours

Export everything, including your photos, whenever you like.

Built for people who like to keep records

When did I last water this? Is it growing? Which routine actually worked? Ploi answers all three.

Ploi Pro is an optional subscription for unlimited plants and photos and automatic rain logging.

name: PlantNet Plant Identification
description:
Pl@ntNet is an application that allows you to identify plants simply by photographing them with your smartphone. Very useful when you don't have a botanist on hand! Pl@ntNet is also a great citizen science project: all the plants you photograph are collected and analysed by scientists around the world to better understand the evolution of plant biodiversity and to better preserve it.

Pl@ntNet allows you to identify and better understand all kinds of plants living in nature: flowering plants, trees, grasses, conifers, ferns, vines, wild salads or cacti. Pl@ntNet can also identify a large number of cultivated plants (in parks and gardens) but this is not its primary purpose. We especially need Pl@ntNet’s users to inventory the wild plants, those that you can observe in nature of course but also those that grow on the sidewalks of our cities or in the middle of your vegetable garden!

The more visual information you give to Pl@ntNet about the plant you are observing, the more accurate the identification will be. There are indeed many plants that look alike from afar and it is sometimes small details that distinguish two species of the same genus. Flowers, fruits and leaves are the most characteristic organs of a species and it is them that should be photographed first. But any other detail can be useful, such as thorns, buds or hair on the stem. A photograph of the whole plant (or the tree if it is one!) is also very useful information, but it is often not sufficient to allow a reliable identification.

At present Pl@ntNet makes it possible to recognize about 20,000 species. We are still a long way from the 360,000 species living on earth, but Pl@ntNet is getting richer every day thanks to the contributions of the most experienced users among you. Don't be afraid to contribute yourself! Your observation will be reviewed by the community and may one day join the photo gallery illustrating the species in the application.

The new version of Pl@ntNet released in January 2019 includes many improvements and new features:
- The ability to filter recognized species by genus or family.
- The differentiated data revision that gives more weight to users who have demonstrated the most skills (in particular the number of species observed, validated by the community).
- The re-identification of shared observations, whether yours or those of other users of the application.
- The multi-flora identification that allows you to search for the photographed plant in all the flora of the application and not only in the one you have selected. Very useful when you are not sure what flora to look for.
- The selection of your favorite floras to access them more quickly.
- The navigation at different taxonomic levels in image galleries.
- The mapping of your observations.
- Links to many factsheets.

The web version of the application is also available at the following address: https://identify.plantnet.org/

name: Flora Incognita
description:
FLORA INCOGNITA - DISCOVER THE DIVERSITY OF NATURE

What's blooming? With the Flora Incognita app, this question is quickly answered. Take a picture of a plant, find out what it's called and learn everything you want to know with the help of a fact sheet. Highly precise algorithms based on artificial intelligence identify wild plants even when they are not (yet) in bloom!

In the Flora Incognita app you can easily view all your collected plant finds in a observation list. Maps show where you have found your plants. This way you can see how your knowledge about wild plants is growing.

But Flora Incognita is even more! The app is free of charge and without advertising, because it is part of a scientific research project that aims to improve nature conservation. The collected observations are used to answer scientific research questions that deal, for example, with the spread of invasive species or the effects of climate change on biotopes.

In regular stories, you will learn about news from the project, get insights into the scientific work or will be made curious about what is happening in nature right now.

WHY SHOULD YOU USE FLORA INCOGNITA?
- Identify wild plants simply by taking a photo with your smartphone
- Learn more about plant species with the help of extensive plant profiles
- Collect your findings in your observation list
- Become part of an innovative scientific community
- Share your findings on Twitter, Instagram & Co!

HOW GOOD IS FLORA INCOGNITA?
Species identification with Flora Incognita is based on Deep Learning algorithms that have an accuracy of well over 90%. It is important to take sharp and as close as possible pictures of plant parts such as flower, leaf, bark or fruit for a high identification accuracy.

WOULD YOU LIKE TO LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR PROJECT?
Visit our website at www.floraincognita.com or follow us on social media. You can find us on X (@FloraIncognita2), Mastodon (@FloraIncognita@social.mpdl.mpg.de), Instagram (@flora.incognita) and Facebook (@flora.incognita).

IS THE APP REALLY FREE OF CHARGE AND ADVERTISING?
Yes. You can use Flora Incognita anytime, as long as you want. It is free to use, with no ads, no premium version and no subscription. But maybe you will enjoy searching and identifying plants so much that it will become a new hobby. We have received this feedback many times!

WHO DEVELOPED FLORA INCOGNITA?
The Flora Incognita app is developed by scientists from the Technical University of Ilmenau and the Max Planck Institute for Biogeochemistry Jena. Its development was supported by the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research, the German Federal Agency for Nature Conservation with funds from the German Federal Ministry for the Environment, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety as well as the Thuringian Ministry for the Environment, Energy and Nature Conservation and the Foundation for Nature Conservation Thuringia. The project was awarded as an official project of the "UN Decade of Biodiversity" and won the Thuringian Research Award in 2020.

PLAN YOUR BACKYARD GARDEN

Design your backyard garden on a visual grid. Map raised garden beds, container gardens, yard plots, and balcony pots. VEGETABLE GARDEN TRACKER

Track every veggie from first seedling to final harvest. The vegetable garden tracker handles tomato, pepper, squash, bean, lettuce, and every other crop you grow. Log photos, notes and milestones for each plant in your garden journal.

Point your camera at any plant and the AI plant identifier names it instantly. Get full care instructions, watering needs, soil preferences and growing zone tips. Perfect for new plants brought home from the nursery, mystery seedlings, or weeds you need to identify.

HARVEST TRACKER

See expected harvest dates for every crop. Plan vegetable successions, avoid a glut, and pick at peak flavor. Whether you grow tomatoes, zucchini, beans, or salad greens, the harvest tracker keeps your kitchen garden organized.

SEED STARTING & FROST DATE PLANNING

Built-in seed starting calendar and frost date alerts for your USDA hardiness zone. Know exactly when to start seeds indoors, when to transplant outside, and when frost threatens. Never lose a tray of seedlings to an unexpected freeze again.

7-DAY WEATHER FORECAST

Weather forecast tailored to your exact location. Frost alerts, heat warnings, and rain forecasts protect every plant in your backyard. Know before you water, know before you plant.

COMPANION PLANTING GUIDE

Built-in companion planting guide shows which plants thrive side by side and which to keep apart. Maximize your vegetable garden yield naturally without chemicals. Perfect for organic gardening and crop rotation planning.

TASK REMINDERS FOR EVERY GARDEN CHORE

Fertilizing, pruning, transplanting, weeding, and harvest reminders - all scheduled automatically to each plant's needs. Never forget another garden task. The reminder system covers every step of plant care, from spring seed starting to fall harvest.

POLLINATOR FRIENDLY GARDENING

Track which plants attract bees, butterflies, and hummingbirds. Build a pollinator-friendly backyard naturally. Perfect for gardeners who want to support local wildlife alongside growing food.

PERFECT FOR

- Backyard vegetable garden growers
- Tomato and herb growers in any climate zone
- Container gardeners on apartment balconies
- New gardeners learning plant care basics
- Raised bed enthusiasts and square foot gardeners
- Anyone planning seed starting or crop rotation
- Houseplant collectors managing watering schedules

Thousands of American gardeners trust GardenPlan every day. Join them and start growing better in your backyard today.

name: Garden Planner: Raised Beds
description:
Garden Planner is a vegetable garden planner for raised beds: a planting calendar built from your growing zone's frost dates, a grid that checks companion planting as you fill it, and a plant library that answers "when do I sow this, and how far apart?"

It works on both sides of the equator. Most apps assume a North American or European spring. Garden Planner has 31 growing zones across North America, Europe, Türkiye, Japan, Korea, China, Russia, Australia, New Zealand, Brazil, Argentina and Chile, South Africa and the frost-free tropics, and southern zones carry southern frost dates. On first launch it suggests a zone from your phone's region setting (never GPS), and you can pick a different zone at any time. Frost dates are zone averages, not a forecast for your yard.

HOW IT WORKS
Pick your zone, create a raised bed sized to your space, and plant into its grid from the library. Mark a planting as sown and the app works out an expected harvest date and puts both dates on your monthly calendar.

WHAT'S IN THE APP
• Planting calendar and sowing calendar: sow and harvest rows for your own plantings, plus a "good to start now" list for the month you are viewing, based on your average last frost date
• Raised bed planner: a grid sized to your space; when two neighbouring cells are a known bad pair, such as tomatoes next to cabbage or beans next to onions, the cell is flagged
• Companion planting library: 20 common vegetables, herbs and marigold with spacing, sow depth, days to harvest, sun needs, whether to start seeds indoors, and the sow week relative to your last frost, plus a companion and antagonist grid; it works without a connection
• Garden reminders: local notifications on your phone when a sowing window opens, when a crop is nearly ready, and three weeks before your average first frost
• AI Bed Planner: enter the dimensions and the vegetables you want, and get a companion-aware garden layout and planting order, limited to the plants in the library so every suggestion can be opened in the app
• Succession Coach (Pro): when you mark a crop harvested, ask what to plant next in that spot
• AI Advisor (Pro): pick a symptom from a fixed list, such as yellowing leaves, holes in leaves or powdery patches, and get possible causes and non-chemical things to try. It is general gardening information, not a diagnosis, and it does not look at photos

FREE AND PRO
Free: the full planting calendar, the whole plant library and companion grid, reminders, one raised bed with unlimited plantings, and three AI bed plans a month. The free version shows ads.
Pro removes the limits: unlimited beds, unlimited AI plans, the Succession Coach, the AI Advisor, and no ads.
Garden Planner Pro is a monthly or yearly subscription, billed through your Google Play account. It renews automatically until you cancel, which you can do at any time in Google Play subscriptions. Restore Purchases is on the subscription screen.

YOUR DATA
No sign-up is needed: the app starts you on a guest profile. Your beds, plantings and garden profile are saved on your phone. The AI features need a connection and send only what that feature needs to our server, which passes it to a third-party AI service: your bed size, the plants you picked and your zone for a plan; the harvested plant and your zone for the Succession Coach; the symptom and plant for the Advisor. The app also uses Firebase analytics and, in the free version, Google AdMob ads. Details are in the Privacy Policy: https://coddykit.com/terms/privacy-policy

WHO IT IS FOR
Home gardeners with a raised bed, an allotment or a few containers who want a simple vegetable plan: what to sow this month, where each crop goes, which companion plants belong together, and when to expect a harvest.

name: Veggie Garden Planner
description:
The Veggie Garden Planner provides you with clearly arranged information that you need to quickly compose your vegetable garden patch.

Before purchase we provide a free download so you can see for yourself what value the app provides.
Choose vegetables that harmonise well together. You will find information regarding good/bad neighbor plants for each vegetable.

For your chosen garden composition you get tabular overviews to quickly determine sowing/harvest times, and which interactions exist between vegetables.

As an bonus feature, you can visually arrange your vegetable patch with our Patch Plan Editor - with vital information regarding planting distance & good/bad neighbors at your fingertips.

Note regarding the climate zone: The seedtimes and harvesttimes are adjusted to hardiness zones USDA 7-8 (e.g. Atlanta, Seattle or Central Europe). Please adapt accordingly.

Our garden planner helps you to quickly and clearly select your desired vegetable and fruit varieties. Improve your harvest by the right plant location, whether sunny location or depleted soil. Then simply plant low-growing plants that will thrive ideally with the sunlight in your garden.

Companion planting:
Pay particular attention to mixed cropping, making sure your planned vegetable varieties get along well with each other in the bed and garden. You will find information on good and bad neighbors for each variety.
Once you have selected your planned vegetables, you can quickly see the interrelationships between the varieties on the neighbor overview. In the clear calendar you can immediately see which vegetables need to be sown when, and from when they can be harvested.

Patch planner:
As a bonus feature, you can use the virtual bed plan to create your patch and freely arrange your desired vegetable varieties. Essential information such as planting distances, location selection, nutrient requirements and good/bad neighbors are displayed directly.

Multiple patchs:
You can also create multiple beds - even for several years. Simply take over the plantings from the previous year and optimize your bed according to your needs.

Own varieties:
If our large selection of vegetables, fruits and herbs is not enough for you, you can also create your own special varieties. For example, take the data of a vegetable and edit it. Take your own photos of your vegetables and customize your varieties.

Pre-plan on the tablet:
Pre-plan your bed on your tablet - save your planning in the cloud - with your smartphone you can wonderfully track or optimize the planning in the garden.

Note regarding the climate zone: The seedtimes and harvesttimes are adjusted to hardiness zones USDA 7-8 (e.g. Atlanta, Seattle or Central Europe). Please adapt accordingly.

name: Partender – Fast Bar Inventory
description:
As featured on Paramount Network's "Bar Rescue" Partender is a patented, subscription-based business tool with a proprietary design that empowers you to:
- Do full, physical bar inventory in just 15 minutes and with up to 99.2% accuracy
- Split up the work across as many users as you'd like on iOS, Android, and even the web
- Generate editable "Smart Orders" based on what you actually went through
- Place, track, and receive those orders online
- Get alerted when prices change
- Get your Usage (for Variance)
- Get your Actual Cost of Goods Sold (COGS for Bev Cost %)
- See what’s trending in your venue such as Top Movers and Dead Stock

And besides saving time and labor, our customers:
1) Reduce Inventory Value On-Hand by 20-40%
2) Reduce Beverage Cost by 6-8%
3) Reduce Cost of Goods Fluctuation by 10%

...all in just 90 days of weekly use after setup.

Here’s what some of them had to say:

"Inventory takes less than 15 minutes now. It used to take 2 hours with 3 people counting, for a total of 6 labor hours."
- Grant S. at Boston Pizza

“It takes us just 15 minutes to do inventory, which we do at least twice a week. We stopped running out of things, and thanks to Partender, we managed to get beverage costs down to 20% in a matter of months."
- Mike W. at Marriott

How? Why?

Because when you count your inventory as accurately and as frequently as you count the cash in your register, less disappears. And the average shrinkage in our industry is 23% because no one's counting how much is there.

So when your inventory is 10-50x more valuable than your cash register, it makes sense to count it as carefully as the till, but that's been impossible until Partender.

So throw out your paper-and-pen and homegrown spreadsheets. Do inventory in minutes - not hours. See what's selling the best/worst, what's dead stock (and needs to get phased out via happy hour promotions), and what's about to run out and get 86'd (so you never miss a sale).

Stop manually typing your inventory into Excel or a glorified web-based spreadsheet. Let Partender streamline all of your inventory, ordering, and accounting operations in just 15 minutes a week.

With Partender, you can also:
- Monitor actual depletions
- See real-time customer insights for your actual customers on a per-product or per-category basis
- Instantly receive your Value On-Hand (like a "Balance Sheet") in wholesale and retail dollars after every inventory
- Optimize your par levels (based on online graphs) to buy more of what's selling the best and less of what's selling the worst
- Clearly understand why your cost of goods is going up (due to Price Change Alerts or due to shrinkage* via our Usage / Variance Report online

*Shrinkage is the loss of inventory due to over-pouring, theft, breakage, spillage, not tracking comps, etc. And there's an average 23% shrinkage in the industry which causes 60-80% of bars and restaurants to fail within 3 years. Or let significant amounts of revenue just walk out the door.

HOW DOES PARTENDER WORK?
Build a virtual "blueprint" of your venue after organizing your bar to split up the work of inventory across Main Bar, Back Bar, Stock Room, etc. Instead of manually writing down your inventory using an arbitrary 10-point scale, cumbersome scales, or expensive hardware, simply tap where the liquor level is on the real image of the bottle and swipe to the next bottle on your shelf. That's it! Our proprietary algorithms are up to 99.2% accurate so you know down to the drop & dollar-value how much each bottle is worth in Retail & Wholesale Dollars ($).

INVENTORY ANYTHING:
In addition to liquor, you can inventory beer, wine, smallwares, kegs, and FOOD! Our database is huge. If there's something on your shelf that's not in our database: take a picture of it, and our proprietary algorithms will do the rest.

ANALYTICS IN THE CLOUD:

name: Home Inventory & Food: InvenDo
description:
Stop throwing away food you forgot about. InvenDo is a home inventory app for your kitchen and the rest of the house: it keeps track of what you have, where it is stored and when it expires, and reminds you in time.

Scan a barcode or type a name, put the item in a storage place (fridge, freezer, pantry, garage, bathroom cabinet), and you always know what is in the house without going to look.

STOP THROWING FOOD AWAY
- Nothing spoils at the back of the fridge again: give an item an expiry date and it is flagged as Expires soon, then Already expired
- A reminder arrives at the time of day you choose, so you use things while they are still good
- Opened a jar or a pack? Mark it opened, and InvenDo sets a Consume by date from the shelf life you enter once, then remembers it for next time

NEVER RUN OUT OF WHAT YOU ALWAYS NEED
- Coffee, diapers, cat food: set a Minimum quantity and InvenDo tells you before the last one is gone
- Everything below its minimum sits on one screen, ready to go onto the shopping list
- Set the minimum for a whole category, not just item by item

BUY ONLY WHAT IS MISSING
- A shopping list built from what your pantry actually lacks, instead of from memory
- Group the list by store, so one trip covers one shop
- Check things off in the aisle, then move what you bought straight into your inventory
- Send the grocery list to whoever is going out, as plain text

ADD THINGS IN SECONDS
- Scan a barcode to add an item, scan again to take one away
- A scanned barcode can fill in the product name and photo for you (available in many countries, not all)
- Start typing and InvenDo suggests things you have had before

FIND ANYTHING WITHOUT SEARCHING THE HOUSE
- Storage places inside storage places: the freezer, then the top drawer
- Categories with colors, and subcategories when you need them
- Photos of your items and your storage places, and an icon for each storage place
- Unit sizes that add up for you: 1 pack = 6 pcs, or 1 pack = 250 g, with the total on hand
- Search your whole home inventory by name or by voice

KEEP THE WHOLE HOUSEHOLD IN SYNC
- Invite your partner, children or roommates by email, and everyone sees the same list as it changes
- Keep several lists (home, parents' house, a hobby collection) and choose who sees which
- People you invite get the paid features on your shared list at no extra cost
- Works offline, syncs when you are back online
- Check the shopping list off from an Android home screen widget, or open your inventory in a browser at web.invendo.app
- Export to Excel whenever you like, or import a spreadsheet you already keep

WHO IT IS FOR
Anyone who wants a pantry inventory that is actually up to date. Food in the fridge, freezer and pantry. Medicines and their shelf life. Cosmetics. Clothes you forget you own. Tools in the garage. Hobby collections. Wine, spices, camping gear, baby supplies, printer cartridges. It is built for a household rather than a business, and it is simple enough that the rest of the family will actually use it.

NO ADS, AND A GENEROUS FREE VERSION
The inventory, storage places, categories, the shopping list, barcode scanning, expiry and low-quantity reminders, Excel export, sharing the list, the widget and sync across devices are all free, and there are no ads anywhere in the app. Premium adds photos, storage icons, Excel import, deeper subcategories, extra lists, inviting other people, filling the shopping list from low-quantity items in one tap, and the web app. Take it monthly, yearly, or as a one-time Lifetime purchase: pay once and use it forever.
