DISCOVER WHAT TO MAKE
Your bar is matched against hundreds of recipes, classics plus seasonal drops, growing every month as members share their own. See what you can pour right now, what you are one bottle away from, and the near misses tagged "Ready, with a sub" with the swap that works. Smart Buy names the single bottle that unlocks the most new drinks on your shelf.

THE BARKEEP, YOUR AI BARTENDER
Chatting with the Barkeep is free on every account. It reads your actual inventory, so it only suggests drinks you can make. It writes the complete recipe right in the chat, measurements and method and glass and garnish, with one tap to save. It checks real published recipes when you want the canonical version of a classic, reads photos of bottles and menus, remembers the conversation, and can stock a bottle for you without you leaving the chat.

THE OPEN BAR
One room every member shares, not a feed. Read the conversation, the tasting notes, the threads, and the Barkeep answering out loud, free on any account. Lurking is welcome. Top Shelf supporters pull up a stool and post.

SHARE YOUR BAR
Friends pull up a stool at your bar as Regulars and see the recipes you choose to share. Every recipe is private by default and you pick the audience per drink. Build drink menus and your guests browse them from one QR code, no app and no login needed. Earn badges as you go.

MORE OF WHAT IT DOES
Flavor Lab: dial in a taste with sliders and the app invents a complete, balanced cocktail, using only your own bottles if you like.
Menu scanner: photograph a restaurant drink list and get the drinks back as real recipes.
Recipe packs: a themed drop of drinks you flip through, save, and make, with more on the way.
Cocktail history: origin stories for the classics.
Export your bar as a spreadsheet, because your bar is yours.
A dark theme built for evening use.

FREE TO START, FAIR FOREVER
No ads. The free tier is a real bar, not a demo: bottle scanning, recipe matching, free chat with the Barkeep, daily AI credits, painted shelf art, saved recipes, badges, a shareable drink menu, and the whole Open Bar to read. The optional Top Shelf upgrade adds a bigger daily AI allowance, your whole bar and cellar painted, as many drink menus as you want, the party hosting tools, and a stool in the Open Bar. Top Shelf is how supporters keep the app running for everybody else.

Whether you are a seasoned mixologist or just getting started, Home Bar Hero helps you make better drinks with what you already have.

description:

It helps you maintain a list of stuff you have, with an efficient interface and easy navigation. The inventory structure is based on real life. You can create lists of items, just like you could on a piece of paper. See Structure section in Help for more details.

Features:
 • Infinite hierarchy: Property ▶ Room ▶ Item ▶ Item ▶ …
 • Categories: 15 diverse categories with 300+ well-defined finer categories
 • Categorization aid based on 2,500+ hand-selected keywords
 • Custom camera to help selecting the item on the picture
 • Move selection of items into any container
 • Advanced search to easily find anything in moments
 • Sunburst chart to see a visual overview of your stuff
 • Import/Export to manually backup or transfer your inventory

When is it useful?
 • You have a remote storage and you don't remember exactly what's there.
 • You're moving, to remember which box contains what.
 • You're tidy and organized and want to know where your stuff belongs.
 • You want to inventory valuable items for insurance purposes.
 • You're not at home, but your family member/flatmate wants something.
 • You want to declutter, you can create a list of stuff you want to throw away.
 • You're transitioning to a minimalist lifestyle and want to share your redundant stuff up for grabs.
 • You're curious how many pens you have lying around the house.

If you're stuck take a look at the Help inside the app.
If you have any question or comment feel free to send a feedback email, I'll answer them.
Please send the error reports if they pop up. The app doesn't have Internet permission, so it can't send automatic crash reports.

description:
Home Inventory App is the private, offline way to catalog everything you own. Record your belongings, photos, serial numbers, receipts and values, then create insurance-ready PDF reports in seconds. No account, no cloud, no tracking: your data never leaves your device.

Preparing for renters or homeowners insurance? Moving house? Want to know exactly what you own and when each warranty expires? This home inventory app keeps your household inventory organized and ready.

📦 CATALOG EVERYTHING YOU OWN
- 30+ fields per item: name, brand, model, serial number, color, size, condition, purchase price, estimated value, purchase date, notes and unlimited custom fields

Create detailed home inventory reports by room, occupant or category, with every photo, serial number and value. Ideal for insurance claims, estate planning and moving day.

💾 BACKUP, IMPORT & EXPORT

🔐 PRIVATE AND SECURE BY DESIGN

description:
Your home, catalogued — now with AI.

Home Inventory AI helps you catalogue everything you own for insurance records, warranty claims, moving, downsizing, or simply knowing what you have and what it's worth. Your inventory lives in an encrypted database on your device — and optional AI features do the typing for you.

ADD ITEMS IN SECONDS WITH AI

• Photograph an invoice or receipt and AI adds every line item at once.
• Ask your inventory in plain words — "what's still under warranty?", "what's my most valuable item?", "serial of my TV?".
• AI runs on credits: start with a few free, then earn more any time by watching a short, optional video. Ads only play when you choose to watch one.
• AI runs online only when you tap it — the relevant photo or text is sent securely and processed by an AI model. Nothing is sent unless you ask, and it's never used for advertising.

CATALOGUE EVERYTHING YOU OWN

• Add an item in seconds—only a name is required.
• Record brand, model, serial number, barcode, price, purchase date, condition, quantity and replacement value.
• Scan product labels and barcodes with on-device text recognition.
• Organise by rooms, categories, and even boxes or containers inside rooms.
• Track item status: owned, sold, donated, lent out or in storage.

BE READY FOR ANY INSURANCE CLAIM

• See the total value of your home at a glance.
• View value by category and room, with breakdowns by condition and purchase year.
• Estimate current value using per-category depreciation.
• Create photo-rich, printable PDF insurance reports with your policy details.

NEVER MISS A WARRANTY

• Record purchase dates and warranty expiry for every item.
• Receive local reminders before a warranty expires.
• See warranties expiring soon on the Analytics screen.

FIND ANYTHING INSTANTLY

• Search names, brands, models, serial numbers and notes.
• Filter by value range, warranty status, missing photos or missing values.
• Scan a QR label or barcode to jump straight to an item.
• Print QR label sheets for boxes and storage containers.

YOUR DATA, PROTECTED

• Your inventory is stored on your device in an encrypted database.
• Unlock the app using your phone's screen lock, fingerprint or a PIN.
• Schedule automatic backups, or back up to your own Google Drive—strictly opt-in and private to your account.
• Export your inventory as CSV or a complete ZIP backup with photos, and restore on a new phone.
• Sign in with Google only to use the AI features. You can delete your server-side AI account data at any time from Settings → Help & FAQ.

PERFECT FOR

• Home insurance documentation and claims.
• Warranty and receipt tracking.
• Moving, downsizing and storage.
• Estate and household planning.
• Collectors and hobbyists.

Catalogue it once. Have proof forever.

name: My Board Game Collection
description:
What if you could have all the information about your boardgames in one beautiful location?
Not only the data coming from the online database (BoardGameGeek), but also your custom data & play sessions.

What if it could translate the information to any language?
We have systems at our fingertips that allow us to translate to any language in the world. We use those systems to allow you to translate descriptions & comments.

By making use of BoardGameGeek & BoardGameAtlas we are able to give you an enourmous amount of information about your collection and/or about board games you want to check out.

No database is perfect so we created a way for you to add to the existing data.
You can add videos (f.e.: how to play), website urls (f.e.: alternate play rules), images (f.e.: your pictures), your notes, game language, tags, purchase date & purchase price and more.

Finding new boardgames can be very exciting, so we are giving you options to be able to find cool new games.
You can view dynamic lists and you can search the database with various filters. Search filters like player count, age, play time, ...

Choosing a boardgame to play is not always easy, that is why we give you multiple options to filter your collection: name, cooperative play, number of players, playtime, release year, is digital, difficulty, tags or/and a favorite.

Even with all these filters it can be hard to choose, some people just have a lot of very cool games in their collection. For these situations we have added a 'pick random' action to the list.

We are a strong believer in open formats so My Board Game Collection uses an open format for its backup/restore files.

Log your play sessions and keep track of what, when and where you played. You can also log who played and who won and with what score. Never forget.

My Board Game Collection is fully usable in its free form, but creating an app requires a huge amount of time and resources. To be able to support My Board Game Collection going forward we have added ads & a couple of premium features. You can remove the ads and unlock the premium features in 2 ways:
1. FREE: You can watch reward videos that will give you ad free time with the app. This ad free time can also be used to use PREMIUM features.
2. PAID: An single in app purchase is available to remove all ads and unlock all premium features.

PREMIUM Features:
- Remove all ads.
- Search images using our in app search screen.
- Change the limit of 2 score / health / resource tracker to unlimited.
- Enable the 'fast jump' on the bottom of the boardgame list.

Check out our social channels to see what is coming, show your support or tell us about any suggestions you might have.
Also available on other platforms. Check out our social channels for more info.

description:

- How many games did you play recently?

- Use tailor-made score sheets to enter scores.

- Keep track of your collection and sync with BoardGameGeek (BGG).

Collection management features of BG Stats:
- Keep track of every game you've played or are interested in.
- Choose a specific version and image, and track multiple copies.
- Set status to Owned, Wishlist, Want to play, and much more.
- Enter details like comments, price paid, acquisition date, etc.
- Filter games on status, Played but not owned, Unplayed owned.

Play tracking features:
- Set scoring rules, cooperative and team play for each game.
- Select game and played expansions.
- Set Players and Locations, including anonymous players.
- Enter location, scores per player and many more details.
- Calculate scores on the fly by using + and - signs.
- Create teams and enter team scores.
- Use over 2500 game-specific tailor-made score sheets.
- Add Player roles, and choose from previously used ones.
- Use a timer to keep track of your play length.
- Add a Game note you can view each time you start a Play.
- Post your plays to BoardGameGeek (BGG), including auto-post after each save.

Statistics features:
- View statistics for each game and player, and combination.
- See pie charts, play times and durations graphs, and score charts.
- View insights for Games and Players, for different time periods.
- See your with H-index, fives, dimes, quarters and centuries.

PLAYING

• Game rules: a target score or round limit that finishes the game for you, reverse scoring for games where lower is better, a starting player that can rotate each round, and an initial score for games that begin with a balance.

• Player profiles with win counts, career stats and avatars (Premium).

YOUR DATA

• Export and import (Premium): games, players and templates to CSV or JSON, and back in from JSON.

• History: every game you have played, searchable, filterable by status, with the leaderboard one tap away.
• Dark, light or system theme with adjustable contrast, and side-by-side layouts on tablets.

PREMIUM
Score Counter is free to use. Premium is a one-time purchase (a monthly plan is available too) that unlocks everything marked Premium above and removes the ads. Some Premium features can be used for a single game by watching a short ad instead.

Focus on the game, not the math!

Import inventory and historical sales from CSV. Match columns and preview quantities, costs and sale details before saving. New unsold units must fit your allowance. Export CSV records or make a full backup with records and photos. Full restore replaces the selected workspace; CSV exports are not full backups. Record a trip's date, purpose, distance and optional route notes. Keep miles and kilometres separate and export your log. Distances are entered manually; there is no GPS tracking or automatic tax-deduction calculation.

Make it your workspace
Answer optional setup questions and choose a useful starting point. Select one of 23 currencies before financial records lock the choice. There is no currency conversion. Core records work offline and stay on your device unless exported or included in device backups. There is no automatic app cloud sync. eBay features and purchases need internet.

Optional Haulfolio Pro
Pro adds unlimited owned unsold inventory. Every other tool is included free. US reference prices are $4.99/month or $39.99/year, each with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. After the trial, your plan is charged and renews automatically unless canceled in Google Play. Google Play confirms eligibility, local price and billing period before purchase. Cancel before the trial ends to avoid the first charge. Existing records remain accessible when Pro ends. Restore purchases restores subscription access, not inventory data.

name: Meal Prep: Planner & Recipes
description:
Meal Prep brings meal planning, recipes, and grocery shopping into one everyday routine. Create a meal plan for the days you choose, find recipes you want to cook, and add their ingredients to a grocery list when you are ready to shop.

PLAN YOUR WEEK, YOUR WAY
Choose the dates you want to plan and select breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Generate a meal plan for a single day, a full week, or a longer date range. See what is on your menu in the calendar, then add a recipe or swap a meal when your schedule changes. A flexible meal planner helps you prepare for the week while leaving room for tonight's dinner ideas.

Choose how often meals repeat as you build your plan. Review suggested dishes before saving them, and look at the calendar when you want to see what is coming up. If a planned lunch or dinner no longer works, replace the recipe or add another meal to the day. Your weekly menu can change along with your schedule.

DISCOVER RECIPES FOR EVERYDAY COOKING
Browse recipes for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and other meals. Search by recipe name or ingredient when you have something specific in mind. Use recipe filters to narrow your choices by meal type, cooking time, food preference, and other options. Open a recipe to see its ingredients, serving information, nutrition details, and step-by-step instructions before you cook.

Need an easy dinner idea, a recipe for an ingredient you already have, or something that fits your cooking time? Search the recipe library and compare options before adding a dish to your meal plan. You can also browse recipes when you only need inspiration for tonight and do not want to plan an entire week.

MAKE YOUR MEAL PLAN PERSONAL
Select food preferences such as vegetarian, vegan, or pescatarian. Set preferred ingredients, ingredients you want to avoid, cuisines you like, and the kitchen equipment you use to guide plan suggestions. Review the suggested meals, make changes, and choose recipes that fit your routine. This food planner gives you a starting point without locking you into a fixed weekly menu.

TURN RECIPES INTO A GROCERY LIST
Add ingredients from one recipe or from your meal plan when you are ready to shop. Adjust the number of portions so ingredient quantities match what you plan to make. View your shopping list by recipe or as one combined list of ingredients. Add items that are not part of a recipe, check off what you have picked up, and share your list when someone else is shopping with you.

The combined grocery list brings matching ingredients together and organizes items for shopping. Switch between U.S. and metric measurements for quantities. If you prefer to keep track of each meal separately, use the by-recipe view. The list is yours to edit: add an extra item, mark an ingredient as picked up, or share the list with someone helping with groceries.

KEEP COOKING FLEXIBLE
Plans change. Move between your meal calendar, recipe details, and grocery list as you decide what to cook. Search for a new dish, swap a planned meal, or add ingredients for a recipe you browsed without putting it on your plan. Whether you are doing weekly meal prep or planning one meal at a time, your recipes and shopping items stay easy to find.

Meal Prep is for people who want a practical meal planning app with recipe ideas and a grocery list that supports the way they actually cook. Plan meals ahead, browse recipes, and shop with the ingredients you need.

name: SuperCook - Recipe Generator
description:
How many times have you found yourself looking for that perfect recipe – only to find that you’re missing one or more ingredients?

How many times have you opened the fridge and thought to yourself -- what can I make ?

How many times have you thrown away an ingredient, because you couldn't figure out how to use it before it expired ?

SuperCook to the rescue!

Unlike other recipe apps, SuperCook only shows you recipes that require the ingredients you already have.

All the recipes you see on SuperCook are recipes you can make right now. No more inconvenient grocery runs for a missing ingredient, at a time when you should be home, with your family and friends

Why purchase new ingredients when you can focus on what you already have?

Here’s how it works:
• For Supercook to do its magic, it needs to know all the ingredients you have at home.
• Visit the pantry page in the SuperCook app and choose from a list of 2000+ ingredients broken down into categories like fruits, vegetables, meats, and many more.
• Start adding ALL the ingredients you have at home to your SuperCook pantry – including oils, spices, and yes - even that old bottle of Worcestershire sauce in the back of the fridge!
• Sit back and watch SuperCook work its magic by finding recipes that match your ingredients.

SuperCook’s Unique App Features:

--Customized Recipe Ideas--
We’ve consolidated over 11 million recipes from 18,000 recipe websites, in 20 languages to create the largest recipe collection ever. This knowledge was fed into an AI system that learnt the intricacies of all ingredients and how they can be mixed together.

All you have to do is build your pantry on the app – and you’re ready to make delicious meals without ever leaving your house!

SuperCook will find you any recipe you need, whether it’s for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or even a midnight snack.

--Easily Add Your Ingredients--
Save time and money with an intelligent pantry. SuperCook’s voice dictation mode allows you to quickly add ingredients to your in-app pantry by simply saying them out loud.

Just open your fridge, click the microphone button, and start listing everything inside. The app will automatically add the ingredients to your pantry for a quick and easy way to find recipes!

--Automatic Recipe Recommendations--
The app will automatically find you recipes to make with what’s in your fridge – so all those lost ingredients in the back of your cupboard now have a place on your table. It’s that simple!

When you run out of an ingredient, simply open the SuperCook app and remove it from your pantry - and all the recipe ideas will adjust accordingly.

A cup of all-purpose flour can weigh anywhere from 105g to 140g depending on whether it is sifted, spooned, or scooped directly from the bag. KitchenConvert applies true culinary bulk density calculations so your recipes yield consistent results every time.

Key Features:

• Dynamic Density Conversion:
Easily convert cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, and milliliters directly to grams, kilograms, and ounces based on real ingredient density.

• Aeration & Packing State Selectors:
Toggle between physical packing states for critical dry goods, including Sifted Flour (105g/cup), Spooned & Leveled (120g/cup), and Packed Flour (140g/cup), as well as loose vs. packed sugars.

• Reciprocal Conversion:
Seamlessly switch directions with a single tap to convert grams back to volumetric measurements when following international cookbooks.

• Multi-Region Cup Standards:
Switch between regional measuring standards without recalculating manually:

US Customary (236.6 ml)

US Legal (240 ml)

Metric Cup (250 ml)

Imperial Cup (284.1 ml)

• Built-In Recipe Scaler:
Assemble a multi-ingredient list in grams and scale yields by half, double, or any custom multiplier instantly.

RecipeTailor is an exact recipe scaler for the way you actually cook: choose a yield, use what you have, and keep every ingredient in proportion.

EXACT RECIPE SCALING

Set the servings you need and RecipeTailor applies one exact factor across every ingredient. Fractions stay fractions instead of becoming rounded guesses. When an ingredient cannot be divided practically — such as an egg, tortilla, or chicken thigh — the app shows usable lower and upper batch plans so you can choose a coherent result.

COOK WITH WHAT YOU HAVE

Tell RecipeTailor how much of an ingredient is available and it finds the largest batch that stays within that limit. Use all of one ingredient when you need to, or set hard maximums for several ingredients at once. Every tailored plan keeps the recipe proportional.

A CURATED RECIPE LIBRARY

Start with five classic recipes free forever, or browse 100+ curated classics across ten categories, from weeknight meals to weekend baking. Every classic can be cloned into your editable personal library. Recipes without a photo still have a designed identity instead of a generic blank placeholder.

BRING YOUR OWN RECIPES

Type a recipe yourself or paste one in. RecipeTailor recognizes ingredient lists and numbered steps, then gives your personal recipe the same exact scaling tools as the built-in library. Add a photo from your device to make a recipe easy to find again.

COOK THE PLAN YOU CHOSE

Cooking Mode opens on the scaled plan, not the original. Follow the steps, track progress, and use included timers without losing the quantities you decided to make.

RECIPE TAILOR PRO

Five classics remain free forever. RecipeTailor Pro unlocks the rest of the 100+ classic recipe library with a monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription. Google Play shows the localized price before purchase; manage or cancel the subscription in Google Play.

Exact scaling, personal recipes, recipe photos, Cooking Mode, import, export, and recipes already in your library remain available without Pro. A recipe you clone stays yours if your subscription ends.

LOCAL BY DESIGN

Your recipes are stored on your device. No account or sign-up is required, and there is no cloud sync. Export one recipe or your complete library whenever you want a portable backup.

RecipeTailor is available in English, Japanese, German, French, Traditional Chinese, Korean, and Spanish.

name: Mealbird: Macro Meal Planner
description:
Most meal planners average your week. Mealbird checks every single day.

Answer a short set of questions: your goal, your body, how much you actually cook, what you won't eat, what you'd spend at the store. Mealbird builds a full week of real meals around your answers, then checks it. Every day's protein and calories are added up from USDA FoodData Central and compared to your targets before the plan is ever handed to you. Not an estimate. Not a weekly average. Arithmetic, per day, shown to you.

WHAT YOU GET

• A seven-day plan. Breakfast, lunch and dinner with real recipes, real portions and real cook times.
• Per-day proof. Every day carries its own protein and calorie numbers and a band showing exactly where it landed, so no day quietly comes up short.
• The math, line by line. Tap any meal to see each ingredient's grams, its USDA entry, and the multiplication that produced the total.
• A shopping list that matches the plan. Grouped by aisle, priced, and checked against the budget you set. The food you eat this week and what the packs cost at the till are shown as two different numbers, because they are two different numbers.
• Repeats, if you ask for them. Say you'll cook once and eat it four times and the plan does that, and tells you which meals repeat.
• Your kitchen, your rules. Diet, allergies, ingredients you love, ingredients you'll never touch, the equipment you own, how many people you're feeding, which meals you make yourself.
• Swap a meal or eat out. Both show you what changes before anything is applied.

WHAT IT WON'T DO

• It won't guess. Every nutrition number on screen is computed from USDA data, not predicted by a language model.
• It won't quietly edit your plan behind your back.
• It won't dress an estimate up as a fact. Grocery prices are labelled as estimates, because they are. Validated nutrition is stated plainly, because it isn't.

SUBSCRIPTION

Mealbird is a subscription, yearly or monthly. The price in your currency is shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Google Play account, and the subscription renews automatically until you cancel it in Google Play under Payments & subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://mealbird.app/terms

name: Jotbook: Bullet Journal & Bujo
description:
Jotbook is a digital bullet journal you can also use for tasks, a diary, and habit tracking. Open and write: jot down a task, an event, or a thought in one short line, move unfinished things forward, and keep it all by day, week, month, and year — like a paper notebook, without a pile of overdue alerts.

WRITE IN SECONDS
Open the app and you are on today’s page. A symbol plus one short line is enough; press return and start the next. No forms, no folders.
• Tasks: things to do — check them off, move them, set them for a later month, or cross them out
• Events: what happened or will happen — meetings, dates, little moments
• Notes: ideas, reminders, anything you don’t want to forget
Type -, o, !, or * to switch the type or add a highlight as you write. Add #tags in the line itself; tap a tag to see everything on that topic. Break a big item into smaller ones. Pick the symbols you like, or tap them above the keyboard.

DAY, WEEK, MONTH, YEAR
Flip through your life the way a paper journal does, without being chased by due dates:
• Daily: one page per day; swipe to change dates. Yesterday’s unfinished tasks show up quietly at the top
• Weekly: the week’s focus, with each day beside it
• Monthly: this month’s list and a look back; things you set for a month reappear when that month arrives
• Yearly: what you want this year, with a month-by-month view
Unfinished tasks can move to another day, a future month, or your own list. Tidying replaces nagging; if something keeps getting moved, Jotbook asks whether it is still worth doing.

YOUR OWN LISTS, PLUS SEARCH
Books, shopping, travel, projects, wishlists — make your own pages, written the same way as your journal.
Everything lives in a simple table of contents. Search any line and jump straight to it.

HABITS
Build a habit or quit one. Count times, or time yourself.
Every day, weekdays, or a few times a week; reminders are optional.
See progress by day, week, month, and year — a year view, streaks, and how often you followed through.
Shrink the timer, tap to pause, hold to stop, and stay on the page.

QUIET AND SIMPLE
It looks like paper. Light or dark, and you choose which day the week starts on.
Optional evening reminders: one minute to look back on today.

WHO IT’S FOR
If you keep a paper bullet journal and want the same way of writing on your phone; if to-do and calendar apps feel too loud; if you want a diary, a planner, and habit tracking in one notebook — Jotbook is for that.

Start writing with Jotbook today.

name: Prompted Journal - Shadow Work
description:
Prompted is a guided journal: a private diary that asks you a question every day, so the writing starts before the blank page can stop you.

It is built for reflection, introspection and personal growth through carefully crafted daily prompts — not just recording how you feel, but giving the feeling somewhere to go. Wellness living, manifestation and shadow work all start from the same place: a question you would not have asked yourself.

WHAT'S INSIDE

- 190+ guided journal prompts for reflection, introspection and shadow work.
- A five minute habit: one daily question, one honest answer.
- "Dive Deeper" follow-up questions on every prompt, for the days you want to keep going.
- Write your own prompts and keep them alongside the catalog.
- A private diary with a biometric lock. Your writing stays yours.
- Daily reminders that keep the habit going.
- A free quote of the day to open each entry.
- Use it as a gratitude journal, a mood diary, a dream diary or a guided journal — whatever your daily writing practice needs.

WHY A GUIDED JOURNAL

A blank page is the hardest part of keeping a diary. A guided journal with writing prompts gives every entry a starting point, so reflection happens even on the days when you have nothing to say. Dedicate five minutes and the practice becomes a routine that supports personal growth, so you can focus on what matters: understanding your inner self.

SHADOW WORK AND INTROSPECTION

Shadow work is the part of journaling that asks about the things you normally steer around. Prompted approaches it the same way it approaches everything else — with a question rather than a blank page. Use the introspective prompts to explore the parts of yourself you tend not to write about, and pair them with mood check-ins and gratitude entries so the practice stays balanced. A shadow work journal only works if you actually open it, which is what the daily question is for.

FOR PEOPLE WHO HAVE BOUNCED OFF JOURNALING

If you have downloaded a journal app before, written twice and stopped, the problem was probably never discipline — it was the empty screen. A daily question removes the hardest decision. Answer it, close the app, come back tomorrow. That is the whole loop, and it is why a guided diary survives ordinary weeks when a blank one does not.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Entries live behind a biometric lock, and your diary stores its entries in local app storage on your device. No account is required: there is no sign-up and no email address to hand over.

YOUR ENTRIES, YOUR COPY

Export a PDF or a CSV through your device's share controls. PDF export is quota-limited on the free tier; premium removes the limit.

FREE AND PREMIUM

Prompted is free to download and the daily practice is free to use. Premium opens the rest of the prompt catalog and lifts the export quota. Price, billing period, renewal terms and any free trial are shown in the app and on this store listing, in your local currency.

A DAILY WRITING PRACTICE

Some people keep Prompted as a self care diary, some as a shadow work journal, some as a reflection app, some as a plain daily record with a question attached. The prompt is the point: it makes the practice repeatable on the ordinary days, which are most of them.

Download Prompted and start today — a private diary with guided prompts for reflection, shadow work and growth.

name: Three Good Things - Gratitude
description:
Three Good Things is a simple gratitude journal for the end of the day — a private daily gratitude diary for positivity, mood and calm.

Every evening, write down three good things that happened and how each one made you feel. That is the whole practice. Write them, then put the phone down.

Inspired by the Three Good Things exercise studied in positive psychology.

WHAT THE APP DOES

- Three good things a day. Short entries, not essays.
- The "I felt" prompt. After each good thing, note the feeling that came with it.
- Memories. Re-read past entries and watch your good days collect over months and years.
- A daily reminder at a time you choose.
- A quote each day.
- Themes, including a night mode for reading in bed.
- Works as a mood diary too: the feelings you note build a quiet record of your moods over the months.

A JOURNAL APP THAT ASKS FOR LESS

Most journal apps hand you a blank page and a cursor. This one asks the same question every evening, so a diary entry is finished in the time it takes to make tea. If you have looked for a free journal app, a gratitude diary or a daily writing habit and bounced off the effort, that is the gap this gratitude app is built for.

PRIVACY

- No account is required. There is no sign-up, and no email address to hand over.
- Journal entries are stored locally in app storage. Exporting or sharing creates a copy through your device's share controls.
- No ads. No AI.

YOUR ENTRIES, YOUR COPY

Export a CSV that can be imported later, or a PDF readable archive. Premium includes unlimited exports; the free app includes three.

FREE AND PREMIUM

The daily practice is free. Premium adds decorative themes and a polished PDF keepsake. Price, billing period, renewal terms and any free trial are shown in the app and on this store listing, in your local currency.

A DAILY GRATITUDE HABIT

Three short entries make a five minute gratitude practice. Done nightly, the gratitude journal becomes a daily habit of noticing — a small act of self care before bed. Some people keep it alongside a longer diary or a mood tracker; this one only ever asks for the good things, so being grateful stays easy.

ABOUT THE PRACTICE

The three good things exercise asks you to name three things that went well and your part in them. It has been studied in positive psychology as a gratitude exercise, and it is deliberately small: the point is that it is easy enough to do on an ordinary evening, in the ordinary mood you happen to be in.

WHO IT IS FOR

People who have started a journal before and stopped. If a blank page has ever felt like homework, this daily gratitude diary asks for a good deal less: three good things, a feeling for each, done.

Download Three Good Things and start your gratitude journal tonight — a simple daily journaling practice for a more grateful evening.

Except here, your good things don't pile up in a list you never reopen. Each one opens a flower, and your plant for the month grows with you: seed, sprout, young plant, flowering shrub, majestic tree. On the last day of the month it joins your garden for good. Twelve months, twelve plants, a whole year you can take in at a glance.

It's a gratitude journal you can watch grow. That's why the habit sticks — and why Calluna works as a self-care diary rather than one more app you forget.

• Three good things, in two minutes flat

name: Moodi: emotions & mood tracker
description:
Moodi is a self-help therapy journal with effective psychological exercises and emotion tracker to strengthen your mental health and overcome anxiety & depression, stress, low self-esteem, or other psychological difficulties. Take advantage of this CBT mood diary therapy and help yourself to raise your mood, increase awareness, and enjoy its anti-stress effect.


A psychological diary is a highly effective self-help practice


Psychologists recommend keeping a psychological diary. It can be an emotion tracker, a mood diary a CBT journal, or free-form entries.


As the best self-help practice, it will help you:


  • Better understand yourself, your thoughts, feelings, reactions, and relationships with other people

  • Express emotions and experiences, rather than suppressing them, and ensure better emotional regulation and stress reduction

  • Approach problem-solving and decision-making mindfully

  • Identify sources of stress and anxiety and find ways to cope with them

  • Improve personal development and growth

Self-help practices you will find in this mental health therapy app


Negative situations diary


A Negative Situations Diary is a very effective self-help technique for solving psychological problems. It will help you cope with painful and anxious moments more easily, understand how some events affect your feelings and mood, and strategize your reactions for similar situations in the future.


Make entries about every negative moment, track your thoughts, mark emotions, and select a cognitive distortion. With this therapy journal, you can better understand yourself, your behavior, and your feelings associated with a specific event. Help yourself to free your mind from negativity, and feel much better. By changing your approach to resolving negative situations, your reaction to them will also change.


Positive moments diary


In the Positive Moments Diary (Gratitude Journal), you can write down all your positive events, good emotions, and gratitude. It helps you pay attention to the pleasant moments and, thus, reduce stress and other negative feelings.


Everything that causes positive emotions truly matters. So, use these positive emotions for self-help mindfully. Whether you had a significant event or something fleeting, write it down and mark the emotions you experienced. And motivate yourself.


Morning diary


With the Morning Diary, you can help yourself set up for the day ahead and free your mind from needless worries, irrational anxieties, and negativity. By practicing this morning diary and mood tracker, you will notice how your energy, motivation, awareness, and creativity rise.


Write down your emotions, feelings, experiences, plans, tasks, goals, and desires every day, immediately after you wake up. Write down everything that seems important to you at that moment.


Evening diary


An Evening Diary is an effective self-help practice. With it, you can track your emotions, feelings, and thoughts at the end of the day, right before going to bed. With this mental health tracker, you can analyze your day and get rid of unfounded worries, stress and tension, anxiety & depression. All this helps you relax, sleep better, and recover.


Write down your events and impressions of the past day. Describe your emotions, feelings, self-esteem, and physical condition in detail. Write down the lesson you learn from this day. Don't try to write it correctly, just be honest and record things you believe to be important for you at that moment.


Download Moodi, a CBT therapy journal and mental health tracker. Put one of the most effective self-help practices on your service. Trace and analyze your negative situations and positive moments, and keep a morning journal and evening mood diary. Learn to save and cherish positive feelings and get rid of anxiety & depression.

description:
KnowDrugs is the easiest way to lookup drug testing results, pill warnings and drug alerts and provides you with drug info about more than 200 drugs, along with advice on harm reduction and safer use. Taking drugs always involves risks - however, if you do decide to take drugs, KnowDrugs can help you to take appropriate measures to reduce potential harms.

DRUG INFORMATION & EDUCATION

Check the profiles of more than 200 drugs for educational purposes: Stimulants like MDMA and Amphetamine, depressants such as Alcohol and Benzodiazepines or psychedelics like 2C-B, LSD and DMT.

KnowDrugs provides you with drug education harm reduction advice, focusing on MDMA / Molly / Ecstasy and other psychoactive substances. Knowing about the wanted and unwanted effects of drugs, their duration, interactions and risks helps you to make more informed decisions, reduce risks and reflect upon your drug habits and consumption behaviour.

DRUG CHECKING, PILL WARNINGS & DRUG ALERTS

Search for drug name, substance or location, to find drug alerts from nearby and learn about their ingredients and dosage strength to avoid overdose and particularly dangerous cuts (e.g. PMA).

Drug checking or pill testing is a way to reduce the harm from drug consumption by allowing users to find out the content and purity of substances that they intend to consume. This empowers users to make safer choices: to avoid more dangerous substances and combination and to use smaller quantities.

If you don't have access to professional drug testing services, looking up recent drug testing results can still help you make a more informed decision about your consumption.

HARM REDUCTION & RESPONSIBLE DRUG USE

Harm reduction aims to minimize the harms associated with recreational substance use. The harm reduction approach follows from the idea that substance use is a high-risk activity that innately entails the possibility of injury, addiction, and death. Therefore, the best strategy one can employ (outside of avoiding use entirely) is to take appropriate measures to mitigate its potential harms.

KnowDrugs highlights the harm-potential of more than 200 substances and demonstrates strategies on how to reduce the harms associated with the consumption of drugs.

KNOWDRUGS CAN ALSO HELP YOU TO:

- learn how to spot and react in case of an emergency, take care of someone experiencing a bad trip at a party or festival
- find a free and confidential counselling service which accepts you and your personal choices, and helps you develop the right strategies and competencies if you want to change something about your consumption behaviour.

Widgets
Track your habits directly from your home screen, with beautiful and colorful widgets.

Completely ad-free and open source
There are absolutely no advertisements, annoying notifications or intrusive permissions in this app, and there will never be. The complete source code is available under an open-source license (GPLv3).

Loop doesn't require an Internet connection or online account registration. Your confidential habit data never leaves your phone. Neither the developers nor any third-parties have access to it.

» How it works:
1. Set up a habit
2. Tell HabitBull how you went for a day
3. Watch your daily streak increase

Habits are no more than routines which you perform subconsciously. To build one - train yourself. To break one, find another one which is similar, yet different and nicer, and repeat it until it sticks.

To assist you with this HabitBull lets you set reminders for each habit and displays them on days when you need to be successful. This is especially useful if you have a to do list with repeating tasks or if you want to be reminded to do the same thing every day. HabitBull does feel a little like a game in which you compete with yourself. The task is to get a long streak for the habit you are working on by covering your goals. The longer the better. As for your vices, HabitBull can be a useful goal tracking tool, or a smart notebook, to assist you while breaking bad habits like nail-biting, drinking alcohol and even improving your dating skills.
It is entirely up to you, really. But why not give it a try and have a convenient helper on the go?

name: Gable: Home Maintenance
description:
Answer three questions about where you live, tick what your house has, and Gable builds the maintenance plan for it — what is due this season, why it matters, and what skipping it usually costs. It is a home maintenance tracker that works the day you install it, with no account, no address and nothing to set up. It is the homeowner app for everything a house needs and nobody reminds you to do.

IT KNOWS YOUR HOUSE
A typical house maintenance app hands you an empty checklist. Gable starts from a curated library of seventy real tasks and keeps only the ones your house needs: gutters if you have gutters, a septic reminder only if you are on septic, the winter list only where winters actually freeze. Three questions — hemisphere, freezing winters, humid season — do the work a location permission would, without ever asking where you live. Change your mind later and the home maintenance manager re-plans around it while keeping everything you have already logged.

WHY IT MATTERS
Every task in this home maintenance app explains itself: why it matters, how to do it, and what it costs to skip. A ten-minute job on an outdoor tap in October, or a burst pipe in January. A filter you forgot, or the furnace call-out you could have avoided. That is the whole argument for a home maintenance tracker — you are not buying a to-do list, you are buying the repair you never have to pay for.

REMINDERS BEFORE THE SEASON
Gable is a home maintenance reminder that arrives before the window closes, not after. One grouped notification for the week ahead, a nudge for anything overdue, and an optional look at the month to come. Never more than a handful at once: a house that has been ignored for a season does not need twenty notifications, and this home maintenance reminder app is built not to nag. Pick the hour they arrive, or turn the monthly preview off.

YOUR HOME'S HISTORY
Mark something done and it goes in the log with the date, a note, what you paid and up to three photos. Over time that becomes the record of your house, which is what a house maintenance tracker is really for: what was serviced, when, and what it cost per year. Like any good home management app, it exports as a PDF or a CSV whenever you want — for a buyer, an insurer, a surveyor, or just for yourself. A home maintenance manager is only as good as the history it keeps, and this one hands yours back on request.

A HOME SCREEN WIDGET
Your house maintenance tracker on the home screen: the next three things, with the count for this month. Tap any of them to open it.

OFFLINE AND PRIVATE
Gable is a house maintenance app that works with the plane on. Your plan, your log and your photos stay on this phone — there is no account to create, no address to type, no cloud to sync to and no server that could lose your data. The only things that leave the device are the purchase itself, through Google Play, and anonymous usage analytics.

NO ADS
A homeowner app should not sell your attention, so there are never any ads. A simple subscription with a free trial, managed or cancelled any time through Google Play.

If you have been looking for a home maintenance app that already knows what a house in your climate needs this month, reminds you in time, and keeps the record afterwards, that is the home management app Gable was built to be.

name: Home Maintenance Reminder
description:
The house never reminds you. It just quietly runs out of time.

When did you last change the furnace filter? Is the water in the emergency kit still good? Did the homeowners policy renew last month or the month before? Every one of those matters, and every one of them disappears the moment it lands in the same list as "buy milk."

Home Maintenance Reminder keeps the house on its own list.

[ ADD IT FROM A TEMPLATE ]

You don't have to work out what belongs on the list. Six categories — basic maintenance, emergency prep, heating and cooling, water and drains, kitchen, contracts and warranties — come filled in with the things a house actually needs.

• Change the air filter
• Replace the water filter
• Test the smoke and CO alarms
• Clear the dryer vent and the gutters
• Test the sump pump
• Check your homeowners, flood and earthquake coverage
• Check appliance and home systems warranties
• Check when the property tax is due
and more

Check off several at once and the first setup takes a couple of minutes. Anything the templates don't cover, you can type in yourself — HOA dues, a vehicle registration renewal. You can edit the templates too, or write your own.

[ A REMINDER BEFORE THE DATE ]

Every task carries its own reminder, and you choose when it lands: on the day, 1 day, 3 days, a week, two weeks, or a month ahead. Cleaning can wait until the morning of. An insurance renewal is easier a month out, while there is still time to shop it.

Reminders arrive at 8 AM, 9 AM, or 8 PM, whichever suits you. They are scheduled on the device itself, so there is no account and no sign-in.

[ DONE MEANS THE NEXT DATE IS SET ]

Mark it done and the next due date is worked out from the repeat you chose — every month, every three months, every year. Tapped it by mistake? Undo it.

Not today? Push it to tomorrow, to next week, or to a date you pick.

[ SEE THE WHOLE HOUSE AT ONCE ]

The home screen draws your house. Each category shows what it is carrying and flags anything overdue, so you read the state of the house in the shape of a house. Below it, everything is laid out by date and colored by how close it is: overdue, today, this week, this month, later.

What you finish is kept, month by month, so "when did we last do this?" has an answer.

[ IT STAYS ON YOUR PHONE ]

Your tasks and your records live in this device and nowhere else. Nothing is uploaded. There is no account to create.

Getting a new phone? Export everything to a file from Settings and load it on the new one.

[ ENGLISH AND JAPANESE ]

The app follows your device language, and you can pin it in Settings.

[ WHO IT IS FOR ]

• Homeowners who mean to keep up with the house and lose track of when
• Anyone who has found an expired emergency kit
• Anyone who would rather not dig out the policy to check the renewal date
• Anyone whose calendar or notes app stopped working for this

[ WHAT IT COSTS ]

Free. You can keep 15 tasks, and if you need more room, watching a short video in Settings adds 5 slots at a time. There are no in-app purchases and no subscription. Ads appear at the bottom of the home and settings screens.

[ PLEASE NOTE ]

This app helps you keep track of your home's maintenance schedule and deadlines. It does not guarantee that any emergency preparation, inspection, or contract renewal is actually carried out, nor does it guarantee your safety. It does not provide insurance, tax, or legal advice. For decisions about coverage or filings, check with your insurer, your local tax office, or a qualified professional. For terms and deadlines that matter, always check your contracts and official documents. If you have any concern about your home's fixtures or its structure, please consult a professional.

FREE TOOLS

• Zeotropic blends: bubble (liquid) and dew (vapor) so SH uses dew and SC uses bubble
• Psychrometric calculator: dry bulb, wet bulb, dew point, RH, enthalpy, humidity ratio
• Delta T, temperature/pressure converters, voltage drop
• Refrigerant reference cards, favorites, and recent tools

PRO — ONE-TIME UNLOCK ($9.99)

• Named Jobs: save and reopen field calculations
• Unlimited PDF reports to share with customers or the shop
• Duct sizing (equal friction / Manual D–style helpers)

• Remove banner ads

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
• Light and dark themes, readable industrial UI
• Local history and favorites on device — no account for core tools
• 18 languages for crews that work across regions

IMPORTANT
Target superheat values are a generic approximation for fixed-orifice systems. Manufacturer charging charts (Carrier, Trane, Goodman, Lennox, and others) can differ. TXV and EEV systems should be charged by subcooling per OEM instructions. PT data is field-grade for service work, not a laboratory REFPROP substitute.

Download HVAC Field Toolkit — EPA study, offline PT/SH/SC, Jobs, and PDF reports in one $9.99 unlock.

name: Hvacio: Serwis HVAC, Przeglądy
description:
Hvacio to mobilna aplikacja dla niezależnych serwisantów branży HVAC w Polsce. Pozwala prowadzić bazę klientów, rejestr urządzeń i historię wizyt serwisowych bezpośrednio z telefonu, także bez dostępu do internetu w terenie. Po zakończonej wizycie automatycznie generujesz protokół serwisowy w formacie PDF i wysyłasz go do klienta jednym kliknięciem.

Aplikacja jest narzędziem profesjonalnym, zaprojektowanym dla osób obsługujących kotły gazowe i urządzenia objęte dozorem UDT, klimatyzacje typu split, multisplit i VRF, pompy ciepła powietrze-woda oraz gruntowe, rekuperatory i wentylację mechaniczną. Sprawdzi się też w serwisie innych urządzeń HVAC, ponieważ formularz wizyty pozwala dostosować listę czynności do typu obsługiwanego sprzętu.

W aplikacji prowadzisz bazę klientów wraz z pełnymi danymi kontaktowymi, adresem i numerami identyfikacyjnymi firmy. Dla klientów biznesowych dane firmy można pobrać automatycznie z rejestru REGON Głównego Urzędu Statystycznego po podaniu NIP, bez ręcznego przepisywania. Bazę można też zaimportować z pliku Excel, jeśli prowadziłeś ją wcześniej w arkuszu.

Do każdego klienta przypisujesz urządzenia, które serwisujesz, wraz z numerami seryjnymi i historią przeglądów. Podczas wizyty wybierasz urządzenie, zaznaczasz wykonane czynności z listy dopasowanej do jego typu i opisujesz zużyte materiały. Wszystko zapisuje się od razu w pamięci telefonu, a po powrocie w zasięg sieci synchronizuje się z chmurą.

Każdej wizycie możesz dorzucić zdjęcia urządzenia robione prosto z aplikacji oraz notatki głosowe nagrywane w terenie. Notatki głosowe pozwalają udokumentować szczegóły obsługi szybciej, niż pisanie palcem na ekranie podczas pracy w kotłowni czy na dachu.

Po zakończeniu wizyty aplikacja generuje protokół serwisowy w PDF, zawierający dane firmy, listę wykonanych czynności, użyte materiały i datę przeglądu. Protokół wysyłasz klientowi e-mailem prosto z aplikacji. W stopce możesz dorzucić link do formularza opinii Google Maps, który pomaga budować pozytywne oceny firmy w wyszukiwarce.

Każdy serwisant otrzymuje publiczną mini-stronę pod adresem hvacio.pl, na której prezentowane są dane kontaktowe i lista obsługiwanych typów urządzeń. Strona ma uporządkowane meta-dane dla wyszukiwarek, dzięki czemu klienci szukający lokalnego serwisu mogą cię znaleźć w Google.

Powiadomienia push przypominają o nadchodzących przeglądach, dzięki czemu nie tracisz zlecenia z powodu zapomnianej daty.

Wszystkie dane synchronizują się przez bezpieczne połączenie HTTPS. Zdjęcia i nagrania głosowe trzymamy w europejskim regionie chmury, we Frankfurcie. Subskrypcję obsługujemy na stronie hvacio.pl, w aplikacji nie ma żadnych płatności wewnętrznych.

Procedura usunięcia konta i wszystkich powiązanych danych dostępna jest pod adresem hvacio.pl/usun-konto. Pomoc techniczna oraz pytania o prywatność: support@hvacio.pl.

Create a routine with a timer for each task. Quickly enter flow state or ADHD hyperfocus and get in the zone while completing your morning routine. If you are doing cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), RoutineFlow is useful for establishing a simple routine.

According to Atomic Habits, routines are context dependent, especially if you have ADHD. That’s why RoutineFlow helps you build on existing good habits and overwrites bad habits by setting a context for each routine. You always know what’s happening before your routine, which is really important for your focus.

name: Exocus: Gamified Focus Timer
description:
Exocus is a pixel-art, gamified focus timer app. Here, your focus is no longer boring, repetitive, or meaningless because every moment of your focus will transform your very own planet.

Do you struggle with staying motivated when you commit to doing something valuable in the long run, like learning new words, practicing an instrument, working out, or mastering a new language? Initially, you're full of enthusiasm, but soon, your passion wanes. Memorizing words becomes a chore, the instrument is neglected, workouts turn into a burden, and progress in the new language stalls...
You start doubting yourself: “Maybe I just don’t have what it takes to stick with long-term commitments.”

That’s not true! Let us explain the real reasons.

● Lack of Immediate Rewards:
You understand the long-term value of these tasks, but how much does this half-hour of focus matter right now?

● Repetition Leads to Boredom:
When the initial novelty wears off, the repetitive nature of the task can make you feel bored and tired.

● Overly Negative Focus:
Focusing on what you haven't accomplished rather than acknowledging what you have done can lead to negative self-evaluation and loss of motivation.

Let Exocus Help You!


====== Exocus Solutions ======

Exocus is a gamified focus timer that visualizes your concentration as a planet's evolution, helping you achieve long-term, pain-free focus.

● Emotional Design and Sense of Meaning
After each focus session, you’ll see the story of what happened to your planet during that time. Even five minutes of focus equals 38.53 million years of evolution for your planet, so your focus is crucial. Want to raise the stakes? You can enable “Hardcore Mode,” where failing to focus might cause your planet to be destroyed!

● Stage-Based Incentives
Short-term Incentives: After each focus session, the planet’s landscape changes and tells you its story.
Medium-term Incentives: After several hours of focus, the planet undergoes more significant transformations, like forming magma, oceans, and land.

Built for power users and tech enthusiasts who demand exact metrics rather than broad estimates, batterywatch delivers real-time telemetry, historical trends, and custom threshold alerts to keep your device operating at peak performance and ultimate stability.

Stop guessing how fast your phone charges or why your battery drains during idle hours. Get exact real-time data with our advanced battery monitor and telemetry suite.

⚡ LIVE BATTERY DASHBOARD & CHARGING SPEED
View real-time hardware telemetry for every single charge session. Instantly measure current voltage, wattage, and exact amperage (mA) flow going into or coming out of your battery cells. Determine your exact charging speed and test whether your charger cables, wall bricks, or wireless charging pads are operating at peak efficiency. With batterywatch, you can benchmark different chargers to see which configuration actually delivers genuine fast charging speed without overheating your device.

🔋 DEEP BATTERY HEALTH & CYCLE TRACKING
Monitor your true battery health and track total cycle count automatically over time. BatteryWatch logs historical charging data to calculate capacity degradation, helping you protect your battery health for years to come. Every chemical battery loses capacity as it undergoes charge cycles; batterywatch helps you quantify that wear. By tracking maximum design capacity versus actual current capacity, this battery monitor gives you transparent data on overall cell degradation.

📈 PRECISION POWER CONSUMPTION & USAGE CHARTS
Analyze continuous power consumption with interactive trend charts ranging from 1 minute to 6 hours. Visualize charge levels, temperature spikes, and amperage draw to pinpoint background apps causing abnormal power consumption. Detailed line graphs make it effortless to identify sudden voltage drops or spikes in power consumption when gaming, streaming, or running intensive tasks.

🌡️ ADVANCED TEMPERATURE & OVERHEAT ALERTS
Protect your hardware from extreme thermal stress and dangerous overcharging. Set customizable threshold alerts for high temperature and battery levels. This battery monitor provides full-screen alerts the instant parameters exceed safe operating limits. High heat accelerates internal battery wear faster than almost anything else. With custom notifications enabled in batterywatch, you get immediate alerts to unplug your charger before heat damages your long-term battery health.

⚙️ ADJUSTABLE TELEMETRY MODES
Tailor sampling frequency to your exact preferences. Choose between Low, Moderate, High, and Ultra tracking modes in batterywatch to strike the perfect balance between granular data sampling and minimal background power consumption. Whether you need hyper-detailed 1-second interval logging for benchmarking chargers or a lightweight background profile, this battery monitor adapts to your specific workflow.

WHY POWER USERS PREFER BATTERYWATCH:

• Deep Telemetry Analytics: Get actionable insight into stabilizing battery health and optimizing daily charge cycles.
• Cable and Adapter Benchmarking: Instantly identify faulty cables or weak power bricks that throttle your charging speed.
• OLED Native Interface: High-contrast Dark Mode interface designed specifically to minimize screen power consumption on modern displays.
• No Unnecessary Bloatware: Focused strictly on providing precision battery monitor metrics without useless background junk or artificial speed boosters.

Take control of your device’s hardware lifecycle. Download batterywatch today to monitor your live charging speed, eliminate unwanted background power consumption, and maximize overall battery health over the lifetime of your device.

name: Diem: Big Group Chat Energy
description:
AI Search, Community Chats

Welcome to Diem! We’re building your new front door to the internet.

Diem is a search-engine-meets-social-network designed first for girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks. You can search the internet with Diem AI and find answers to anything life throws at you. “How do I get over a friend breakup? What’s the best way to negotiate salary? My boyfriend follows models on Instagram—is that a red flag?” Diem is here to help.

Our platform is also full of novel, collective knowledge from people all over the world. You can socialize your search to start conversations, discover a network of communities, connect over shared experiences and browse trending topics.

Joining Diem means showing up with no judgment and immersing yourself in the candid, funny, authentic, important, supportive, outrageous, honest, and wholesome questions of other Diemers, which span everything from birth control to friendship, sexuality to pop culture, parenting to relationships, money to reproductive health, career to books, and so much more. Diem feels more like searching for answers in the girls’ bathroom than spiraling alone on the internet.

Here’s what you can find in the app today:

Diem AI-powered search

Ask Diem AI, our AI-powered search tool, your questions! Our search engine is designed to be less bias than other models. You can think of Diem AI as your most knowledgeable Virgo “big sister” who lives in your back pocket. Diem AI draws from across the internet and the collective wisdom of Diemers to generate you a speedy answer. When you ask Diem AI you’ll receive a short summary answer, community sources (previous, related conversations in Diem), community spaces, web pages, Reddit threads and TikTok videos. You can dive in to these search results OR you can post your search to the community feed to get real-time feedback from people who’ve been there.

Diem AI Lenses

You can now ask questions of leading experts and your fave creators in Diem. Ask their Lens anything and your search result will feature their opinions & content from across the internet.

Discover thousands of authentic conversations

From awkward sex questions to wholesome big sisterly advice or navigating life’s highs and lows, Diem is full of the collective knowledge of girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks in over 100 countries.There’s no judgment here and you’ll feel that very quickly.

Post anonymously or under a pseudonym

We think of the anonymous feature as a confidence booster. Sometimes posting ‘taboo’ questions or personal stories publicly can be nerve-wracking, so this feature is designed to make you feel more comfortable while getting the advice you need.

Community Spaces

Community Spaces are micro communities that are also discoverable when related questions are searched via Diem AI. A few currently live: Am I wrong?, Big Sis Advice (BSA) and Is this Normal…? (ITN) We’re still early in building out Spaces and you can request additional Spaces or host your own.

Creating Posts

If you have a longer story, recommendation or advice to offer you can click the + button on your Discover feed and type out all your stories or wisdom. These posts will be discovered via the search engine and in Diemer’s discovery feeds.

Upvoting & Bookmarking

See a post or response you want to save for later or give some love to, click to bookmark, “heart” or upvote it!

Safety & Privacy First

Safety & moderation are our top priority at Diem. See something, say something! We have distributed moderation—if you report something, we review it, ensuring there’s no violation of the community culture. We also take your privacy very seriously—whatever you search is your business.

We’re still early in our journey to build Diem into your new ‘front door’ to the internet, if you have any problems or ideas for the app, get support at help@askdiem.com.

Happy Dieming!

Privacy Policy: https://www.askdiem.com/privacy-policy

name: Food Allergy Scanner - Bokha
description:

We've all been there in the grocery aisle, wondering whether a product might contain something problematic. Bokha is designed to help you review product data faster — for yourself, and for everyone you shop for.

With a quick scan, Bokha shows:
• A simple green, yellow, or red indicator based on allergen matches found in the database
• Allergens and traces declared in the product data, including wheat
• A handy history of previously scanned products

Need to check a whole cart? Turn on bulk scan and keep scanning products one after another, without stopping between each barcode.

Shopping for more than one person? Create profiles so each person has their own allergens to detect, scan history, and favorites.

How does it work?
1. Open the app and set the allergens you want to detect — including wheat, gluten, milk, nuts, and more
2. Scan a food barcode, or keep scanning in bulk without interruption
3. Get immediate results showing whether matching allergens are found in database data
4. Switch profiles when you're checking products for someone else
5. Save products you want to revisit

Useful features:
• Fast detection of common allergens, including wheat
• Bulk scan to review many products in a row without interruption
• Multiple profiles, each with their own allergens, history, and favorites
• Clear, color-coded alerts
• Personalized results based on the active profile's selected allergens
• A growing list of products with no matching allergen found in database data
• Easy sharing with family members

Premium gives you:
• Unlimited product scanning
• Bulk scan mode
• Multiple user profiles
• Full scan history
• Detailed additive information
• Unlimited favorites
• More comprehensive product analysis

Bokha connects to Open Food Facts, a collaborative database with thousands of products worldwide.

Bokha is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition.
Always verify packaging and ingredient labels before consumption, and consult a qualified healthcare professional for allergy-related decisions.

name: ALLiCANEAT - Food Intolerances

ALLiCANEAT adjusts to your individual intolerances, allergies and sensitivities and calculates a personal tolerance rating for each food. You can combine several factors at once – for example lactose, fructose, histamine, gluten, sorbitol, FODMAP, cow’s milk, egg, soy, wheat, tree nuts or additives.

Search quickly for specific foods and use the simple traffic light system – green, yellow, orange and red – to see which foods are more suitable for you and which ones you may want to be more careful with.

You can also scan product barcodes. ALLiCANEAT checks the available product data and shows how well the product matches your selected intolerances, allergies and personal settings.

Browse categories such as beverages, fruit, dairy products, grain products or sweets, or filter foods by traffic light color – for example to show only green and yellow entries.

For many foods, ALLiCANEAT also provides detailed information, including lactose, fructose, glucose, histamine, sorbitol, salicylic acid, amines, amino acids, the fructose-glucose ratio, histamine liberators, DAO inhibitors and other relevant properties.

If you tolerate a food better or worse than suggested, you can save your own personal rating and adapt ALLiCANEAT even more closely to your everyday life.

No more searching through different lists, comparing ingredients manually or memorizing numbers. With ALLiCANEAT, you manage your foods, intolerances, allergies and product checks in one place.

description:
AllergenLens reads the ingredient list on packaged food and highlights anything that matches the allergens and diets in your profile, including "may contain" warnings and less obvious names like whey, casein or tahini. Scanning happens on your phone, and your health details never leave it.

WHO IT'S FOR
• People with food allergies, celiac disease or a food intolerance
• Parents checking snacks for a child's allergy
• Vegans, vegetarians and anyone avoiding gluten or lactose
• Travelers reading labels and explaining their allergies in another language

HOW IT WORKS
1. Set up your profile: allergens, diets and ingredients of your own
2. Scan the ingredient list, pick a photo or type the text
3. See a clear answer, with every matching word highlighted

YOUR PROFILE
• The FDA's major 9 allergens: milk, eggs, fish, crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans and sesame
• The rest of the EU's 14: cereals containing gluten, celery, mustard, lupin, molluscs and sulphites
• Vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free and lactose-free diets
• Add ingredients of your own
• Mark each one as an intolerance, an allergy or a severe allergy; the most serious matches are listed first

READS THE WHOLE LABEL
• Scan live with the camera, pick a photo, or type the text
• Finds the ingredient list and the "Contains" and "May contain" statements
• Reads labels in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese and Dutch

KNOWS OTHER NAMES
• Derived ingredients count toward their allergen: whey, casein and ghee as milk; albumin as egg; semolina, spelt and couscous as wheat; marzipan and praline as tree nuts; arachis oil as peanut; tahini as sesame
• Ingredients and E-numbers with more than one possible source, like lecithin (E322), are marked to check

FOUR CLEAR ANSWERS
• Contains: something from your profile is in the ingredients or a "Contains" statement
• May contain: the label warns of possible cross-contact
• Not found in the text we read: no match, which isn't a guarantee
• Couldn't read clearly: part of the label was blurry, cut off or too small
Every flagged word is highlighted, and a coverage indicator shows how much of the label was read.

FREE, WITH NO SCAN LIMIT
Scanning and every warning are free: one profile, unlimited scans, all four answers, highlighted matches and the coverage indicator. No account and no ads.

ALLERGENLENS PLUS
Plus adds convenience, never protection:
• Up to 6 family profiles, with Whole family mode to check everyone at once
• Scan history with label photos, search, filters and saved products
• Travel allergy cards in 9 languages (English, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese and Korean), full screen and offline, to show at a restaurant or shop
• Save travel cards as an image or PDF

• Yearly: $14.99 per year, with a 7-day free trial
• Monthly: $1.49 per month for the first 3 months, then $2.99 per month
• Lifetime: $29.99 once, with no renewal

Prices are in US dollars and vary by country; Google Play shows your price before you buy. Payment is charged to your Google Play account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically at the full price unless cancelled before the current period ends. Cancel during the free trial and you won't be charged. Manage or cancel any time in Google Play under Payments & subscriptions.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Profiles, label photos and results stay on your phone. There is no AllergenLens server.
• Your allergies and diets are never sent to analytics, advertisers or us
• Anonymous usage statistics can be turned off in Settings

PLEASE NOTE
AllergenLens helps you read labels. It is not medical advice and it can miss things: text can be misread, labels can be incomplete and recipes change. Always read the label on the package, ask the manufacturer when unsure, and if you have a severe allergy, follow your doctor's plan.

name: Open Food Facts
description:
🔍 Scan, Discover & Compare Over 4 Million Food Products


The app allows to scan the 4 million products already contained in the free and open database Open Food Facts.
The app is collaborative. If we don't have the product, you can add pictures and data to get the Nutri-Score and NOVA score on food processing.

In short, we're kind of "the Wikipedia of food", as many have nicknamed the project. Open Food Facts has enabled the creation of over 100 apps like Date Limite, Yuka or FoodVisor.

🥦 Make Healthier Food Choices



➜ The Nutri-Score grade, from A to E : Nutritional quality
➜ The NOVA group, from 1 to 4 : Avoid ultra-processed foods (Group 4)

🌍 Join Our Mission for Food Transparency



➜ Open Food Facts is a food products database made by everyone, for everyone.
➜ You can use it to make better food choices, and as it is open data, anyone can re-use it for any purpose.
➜ You can start contributing today by adding a product from your fridge.
➜ Open Food Facts is a non-profit project developed by thousands of volunteers from around the world. We have lots of exciting projects you can contribute to in many different ways.

🏷️ Decode Food Labels with Ease



➜ Open Food Facts helps you decipher products labels. You will be able to find:
➜ carbon footprint (CO2 emissions) and packaging (as well as recycling instructions),
➜ Nutriscore (nutritional score), nutrients, fat / fat content, saturated fatty acids, carbohydrates, sugars, fiber, protein and salt and sodium.
➜ brands, allergens, labels (bio, gluten free, vegan, vegetarian, halal, kosher ...), traceability information (packaging codes, origins of ingredients)
➜ On wines and beers, you will find the alcohol content.

🔬 Backed by Science, Supporting Research


➜ We don't make up things. We rely on peer-reviewed science.
➜ The Nutri-Score has been created by the independent French team led by Professor Hercberg.
➜ The NOVA groups on food processing have been designed by the international team of Professor Monteiro.
➜ The additives synthesis is based on reviews by EFSA on exposure levels on food additives.
➜ The Open Food Facts community is collaborating with research teams across the planet to improve nutrition research that benefits all.

🔒 Your food, your data. Privacy-Centric App


➜ Your data is yours, and is never sent online
➜ You can use the app anonymously
➜ You can export your scan history

🚨 Set Allergen Alerts


➜ Milk, Gluten, Eggs, Soybeans, Nuts, Fish, Celery, Mustard, Sulphur dioxide and sulphites, Peanuts, Sesame seeds, Crustaceans, Molluscs or Lupin allergy ?
➜ Speed up your shopping by doing an initial screening of your food with Open Food Facts.
➜ Be careful that the information may not be 100% accurate, and detection may not be 100% accurate. So always double check by yourself, with the packaging.

💰 Open Prices: Transparency on Food Costs


- Contribute to Price Transparency. When you shop, add the price on the shelf, or at home, add the receipt. Let's track shrinkflation, cheapflation & more.

💄🧴🐶 More Than Just Food: Scan All Your Products


Open Beauty Facts: Scan cosmetics and hygiene products. You can check for ingredients you want to avoid by setting up "ingredient bans" to get personalized alerts.

Open Pet Food Facts: Find information on food for your furry friends.

Open Products Facts: Discover information on all other products (e.g., electronics, toys, clothes). This database helps you make more circular choices and increase the life of your products.

🌐 Open Food Facts: More Than An App

After years of doing the same research over and over, I had one thought:

Personally researched by our team, complete with detailed notes about cross-contact procedures, kitchen practices, dedicated fryers, and staff knowledge.

No mystery ratings.

Find trusted restaurants along your exact driving route.

Browse gluten-free options in more than 100 airports, organized by terminal.

Because the best trips are the ones where you spend your time making memories, not searching for your next meal.

NO PAY-TO-PLAY.

Restaurants can't pay to be featured. No ads influencing what you see.

Every restaurant is here because it earned its place.

Because trust is everything.

SAVE MONEY.

Living gluten-free is expensive enough.

Gluten Dude members get exclusive discounts on hundreds of gluten-free products to help make it a little easier.

TRUSTED BY THOUSANDS.

"Your approach is far superior to other apps in terms of safety. Your app is desperately needed." - Sandy

"Love the app when I was planning a road trip! So nice being able to see different routes with GF options!" - Kristen

FROM SOMEONE WHO GETS IT...

I know what it's like to stand outside a restaurant wondering if you're making the right decision.

I know what it's like to be tired of second-guessing every meal.

That's why Gluten Dude exists.

Not to tell you where to eat.

To help you feel confident about where you choose to eat.
